programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 & 111
programme.desc: Pianist Alexandre Tharaud's interpretation of Beethoven's last three sonatas - Opus 109, 110 and 111. Beethoven's last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world. This "psychological framework" is explored by director Mariano Nante, setting pianist Alexandre Tharaud in a film inspired by the universe of Tarkovski. Filmed in abandoned castles, and lit by... director of photography Yorgos Arvanitis, this work evokes solitude and introspection and offers an inner j ourney through images and music.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021. Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for... strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is D vořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák's broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world's leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide. The Oslo Philharmonic was celebrated for its fresh, open sound and for Jansons's passionate interpretations of works by Dmitri Shostakovich, Richard... Strauss, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, and Béla Bartók. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is... particularly evident in the rehearsal process. Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the "Symphony of a Thousand," is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer's obsession with Goethe's legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death. It's a fable that defies definition – both a tragedy and dark comedy, with a central character both wise and... despicable, and a play and epic poem in one.

Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K.... 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as th e 'Prague Symphony'.

In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven's loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn's and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors. For instance, the work opens with a slow introduction that refuses to reveal the piece's key.... Equally remarkable are the unusual prominence of the woodwinds, and the scherzo-like tempo of the third movement bearing the indication 'minuet'. programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's 9th Symphony captivates through its profound emotional depth and vulnerability, especially the breathtakingly beautiful and spiritually resonant Adagio that concludes the work, offering a profound sense of closure and transcendence. Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death. Audiences are drawn to the symphony's deeply personal expression of vulnerability and its transcendent final movement, which serves as a poignant farewell and a profound exploration of the human condition.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: One of the world's most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel's Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard's death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard's nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under... the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises. Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, 'Resurrection'. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. Its... first movement resembles a funeral march, while the second, a graceful Ländler, creates a stark con trast with the somber character of the first. The third movement is a Scherzo based on Mahler's musical setting of 'Des Antonius von Padua Fischpredigt' from the collection Des Knaben Wunderhorn. The composer also used another Wunderhorn poem, 'Urlicht' (Primal Light), for the fourth movement, incorporating both text and music, sung by the alto. The chorus makes its entrance in the second part of the fifth and final movement with the 'Resurrection' chorale. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Marco Sollini, Salvatore Barbatano. Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century's most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music. The Romantic period was the era of the virtuoso pianists: the piano was the instrument of choice for countless musicians and... listeners alike. No house of standing could do without a piano: it was a status symbol. Piano music was play ed in concert halls, palaces, salons, churches and public houses alike. Liszt's symphonic poem no. 4, 'Orpheus', breathes a meditative atmosphere. No. 3, 'Les Préludes', is best known in its symphonic version – the piano version presented here is rarely heard. The work dates back to the period 1848 – 1854 and was initially meant to serve as introduction to a choral cycle to be based on the texts of the poet Joseph Autran, 'Les quatre éléments': earth, air, water and fire. In this broadcast, the Italian piano duo of Marco Sollini and Salvatore Barbatano performs these Liszt piano works. These recordings were made at the beautiful 12th century church of San Marco in the small but picturesque village of Ponzano di Fermo, as part of the 2015 edition of the annual, itinerant festival 'Armonie della sera' in the Italian province of Le Marche.

In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet. The young composer started writing the Piano Quartet in C minor in the spring of 1884 and completed it one year later. The work is in four movements and shows... considerable influence from Johannes Brahms. It premiered on December 8, 1885 in Weimar and was perfor med by members of the Halír Quartet with Strauss himself playing the piano part. The following year the work won the first prize given by the Berliner Tonkünstlerverein for a piano quartet. This performance was recorded at the Stiftkerk in Weerselo, the Netherlands.

It opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, known as the 'Nannerl-Septet'. Mozart composed it in 1776, probably on the occasion of his sister Maria Anna's name day, whose nickname was 'Nannerl'. The septet is scored for oboe, two horns, two violins, viola and double bass. The program... continues with Ludwig van Beethoven's Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, b assoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven's lifetime. It was arranged for many various instrumental ensembles, including versions for two guitars, and piano four-hands, but also a trio for clarinet (or violin), cello, and piano, arranged by Beethoven himself.

Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber... music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both t he concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played... without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. Th e joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement 'Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, 'Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the... best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often in terpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which... covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébene explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called 'curse of the ninth,' did not want to write a Symphony No. 9. After all, fellow composers Ludwig van Beethoven and Anton Bruckner died before writing their tenth symphonies. Mahler's Symphony No. 9 premiered on... June 26, 1912, in Vienna, performed by the Vienna Philharmonic led by Bruno Walter. Unfortunately, the composer himself did not live to see this: he died in 1911. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner. In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The German-born conductor, who became a Dutch citizen through naturalisation, was chief conductor at the Dutch National Opera, the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra, and the Netherlands Chamber Orchestra before he was finally knighted for his services to the Dutch music landscape. The majestic opening theme of the first... movement of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. Th e doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner. Bruckner's use of Wagner tubas and double bass tubas creates an even more solemn and grandiose air within the Adagio. Trumpet signals refer to crowing cockerels as they interrupt the grim and clamorous Scherzo. In the Finale, Bruckner employs a persistent rhythmic pulse that starts softly yet builds up towards the explosive final bars.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Audiences are captivated by the symphony's immense emotional journey, from the dark existential questioning to the triumphant, exhilarating affirmation of life in its famous choral finale. The sheer scale and dramatic power, combined with the profound spiritual and philosophical message of resurrection, create a profoundly moving and unforgettable concert experience. Mahler's "Resurrection" Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale. The symphony features immense orchestral forces, including offstage brass and a large choir, which combine to create overwhelming sonic experiences that depict profound spiritual and emotional narratives. The grand scale and... dramatic structure represent the triumph of life over death.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: A symphony of tender, transparent beauty and comforting, childlike simplicity. The work's unique portrayal of paradise through a child's perspective offers a refreshing contrast to the more complex and often turbulent works in Mahler's output. Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuid in a performance of Richard Danielpour's Elegies. Soloists are Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone). Recorded at Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands, 2019. Richard Danielpour (.1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein. Thus, he conveys an intense musical experience to the listener with his intuitive musical style, his exquisite melodic lines and... accessible harmonic language. All this makes him to be a hugely popular composer with American orchestr as. The initial idea for the composition of a song cycle "Elegies" came from the American mezzo soprano Frederica von Stade who was born in 1945, the same year in which her father was killed when the Jeep he was driving drove over a land mine. Charles von Stade is buried at the American cemetery in Margraten (South Netherlands). His daughter could thus only create a picture of him for herself via family stories and through his letters. These letters form the basis of the text of the songs, where father and daughter "meet" and communicate for the first time. The first movement Vigil, depicts the arrival of the daughter who hopes for a spiritual connection with her father. The second movement describes the intense sorrow of her father at the horrors of war and is as if his daughter is calling on him to return to her. In the third movement we hear the father give his unborn daughter his blessing, "Little soul, to where would you go from the darkness of the womb?" Movement four is the preparation for the reunion of the souls of father and daughter which takes place in movement five, Paradise. Here the daughter welcomes her father's spiritual rest and sings, "Peace, the air which I breathe". The philharmonie zuidnederland is conducted by Harmut Haenchen. The German born conductor who naturalized to become Dutch and was chief conductor of the Dutch Opera Amsterdam, the Dutch Philharmonic Orchestra and the Dutch Chamber Orchestra from 1986 to 1996. He was knighted for his services to Dutch music. Harmut Haenchen is a regular guest conductor with the philharmonie zuidnederland. Conductor: Hartmut Haenchen Orchestra: philharmonie zuidnederland Soloists: Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone).

programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the... musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6;... and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmoni e de Paris on November 24, 2020. Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which... covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébene explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: One of the world's most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel's Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard's death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard's nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under... the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises. programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece's title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean... Paul, who defines humor as "an infinity of contrast", "a setting of the small world beside the great" , and where "a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness". In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece's title refers to humor as an emotional state. Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Kirill Karabits conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 4. Soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Recorded on December 8th, 2021. Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler's Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child's vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty. With soprano Lucy Crowe lending her vocal radiance to this extraordinary finale, the... symphony's journey to bliss is complete. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on December 8, 2021.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In the documentary 'Hans van Manen – Moving to Music' (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets. Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In the documentary 'Hans van Manen – Moving to Music' (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most... successful ballets, including the then-controversial Metaforen (1965), which featured the first male p as de deux, Adagio Hammerklavier (1973), and Sarcasmen (1981). Film director Reiner E. Moritz also included contributions of friends and colleagues, such as Ted Brandsen (Dutch National Ballet), Martin Schläpfer (Vienna State Ballet), and Van Manen's partner Henk van Dijk, rounding off the portrait of the great choreographer.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. This performance was recorded at the Aram... Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021. Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the... work representing the artist's beloved, an 'idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scor ed for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Margarita Höhenrieder, Staatskapelle Dresden. Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven's Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece. Together with his septet and First Symphony, this piano concerto was finally performed at his official Vienna debut on April 2, 1800 at... the Hofburg theatre, with Beethoven himself at the piano. The composer had long ceased to be an unknow n in Austria's capital: he had been playing private concerts all around town for years.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020. Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach's Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany. J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a... group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarka ble combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of... the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last... movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer's most popular. programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014. Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of... his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the thir d movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Strauss, Beethoven & Schoenberg
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Strauss' Horn Concerto No. 1. This work is one of the most popular and frequently performed horn concertos written in the 19th century, and the first orchestral piece the composer wrote for the instrument. The soloist for this performance is the DNSO's principal horn player Lasse Mauritzen. Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Strauss' Horn Concerto No. 1. This work is one of the most popular and frequently performed horn concertos written in the 19th century, and the first orchestral piece the composer wrote for the instrument. Strauss' father, Franz, was a virtuoso horn player, and one of the leading performers of his time. Also featured in this program are performances of Beethoven's immortal Symphony No. 7 and Schoenberg's early... work Verklärte Nacht. The soloist for Strauss' virtuoso Horn Concerto is the DNSO's principal horn pla yer Lasse Mauritzen. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer's only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This... performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary 'Approaching the Maelström' follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass's composition 'A Descent into the Maelström'. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe's 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass's work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. The 2019 documentary 'Approaching the Maelström' follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass's composition 'A Descent into the Maelström'. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe's 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass's work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty... years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass's work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the... Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.desc: Když jsme se naposled setkali s Gumballem, zrovna mačkal tlačítko zpětného chodu na Robově univerzálním dálkovém ovladači, protože chtěl předejít tomu, aby uvízl ve Velké prázdnotě. Dálkové ovládání teď Gumballa zavedlo na začá.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Když si Rob v obchodním domě zakoupí univerzální dálkové ovládání, zjistí, že může ovládat celý vesmír. Přetočí ho zpátky do minulosti a vzpomene si, že kvůli Gumballovi uvízl ve Velké nicotě, odkud sice vyvázl, ale trvale pozn.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumballa a Darwina už nebaví věčně poslouchat Mollyiny dlouhé a únavné vtipy, a tak se rozhodnout naučit ji vyprávět je zábavnějším způsobem. Když se jim to nepovede, napadne je, že musejí Molly zprostředkovat příběh, který bude st.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Na trhu dojde k záměně Lamputa za vodícího psa a doktoři jsou v zoufalé pozici. Musí se proplížit k někomu domů a provést velmi tichý únos slizu. Dáma chce jen klidně relaxovat a možná má štěstí, že nevidí ten zmatek okolo.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin jsou přesvědčení, že se daného dne nic zajímavého nestane. Vydají se proto do Elmoru, aby natrefili na nějaké dobrodružství, čím dál víc je ale jasné, že práve jim se vzrušující zážitky přímo vyhýbají.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Nicole se usmíří se svými rodiči.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Táta způsobí zmatek v budově firmy Chanax, kde si ho spletou s místním ředitelem. Máma a nespokojení zaměstnanci pak musí všechny zachránit před Richardovými nebezpečnými nápady.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin se na 5 minut ujmou Larryho práce a zjistí, jak je náročná.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Technika získá lidskou inteligenci, jenomže pak začne napodobovat lidské nedostatky a začne být nefunkční.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin hledají zdravou alternativu k Bezva Burgeru. Ale zlotřilá potravinářská společnost vlastní monopol na potravinářský průmysl.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Nicole si připadá svojí rodinou nedoceněná; nachází útěchu u asistentky umělé inteligence Auri a spřádá plány na likvidaci vlastní rodiny.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Šéf zjistí, že jeho halloweenské triky děti nikdy nevystrašily a je z toho zničený. Letos je ale chce vyděsit stůj co stůj a přenechá strašení Gwen. Její plán nakonec dosáhne strašidelnějších rozměrů, než Šéf čekal.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Courtney se odmítá dělit o karamelkovou výhru z matematické soutěže. Je proto přenesena do blízké budoucnosti.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Krotitelé zlých chlápků se musí opět spojit, aby zachránili Izzy, když Harold objeví její původní identitu a zavede super zloducha z její minulosti přímo za ní.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Šéf zapomene heslo k počítači. Jediné, na co si vzpomíná je, že to má něco společného s předchozími devadesáti devíti výbuchy. Musí si vzpomenout, jinak školka vybuchne po sté.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Gumball musí pomoci řediteli Brownovi získat sebevědomí, aby mohl na recitálu poezie zazpívat svou báseň "Samá pozadí".

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Večeře s babičkou Jojo hrozí katastrofou, pokud si Richard nevzpomene na "tu věc", o které s Nicole mluvili.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Technika získá lidskou inteligenci, jenomže pak začne napodobovat lidské nedostatky a začne být nefunkční.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Hektor je nešťastný ze svojí výšky, a tak kluci použijí jeden z lektvarů paní Jotunheimové, aby ho zmenšili, jenomže to dopadne katastrofálně.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumballův nepřítel Rob si přeje se ho jednou provždy zbavit, a tak divákům navrhuje celou řadu pořadů s jinými hlavními postavami, než je Gumball. Bohužel pro Roba je jeden horší než druhý.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Rodiče Penny jsou nespokojení, že se rozhodla zbavit své skořápky. Penny si přeje, aby i celá její rodina konečně opustila své skořápky. Rodina neví, na koho se má v této vyostřené situaci obrátit. Řešení je však nasnadě.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin se ocitnou v potížích, když souhlasí se vším, co řekne nový kluk ve škole. Pravda je o to složitější, že mu nerozumí ani slovo. Peter Pepperoni se až doteď vzdělával doma a vytvořil si tak zvláštní způsob mluvy.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Richard neotevře dostatečně rychle dveře a poslíček, který se mu za to chce pomstít, mu proto nepředá jeho zásilku. Richard má na vybranou: buď si zásilku vyzvedne v depu, nebo si ji nechá znovu doručit. Jenomže Richard nechce ani jedno,.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Gumball chce dostat Richarda do týmu roztleskávaček, aby ukončil mezigenerační trauma jejich rodiny.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Penny spolu musí zůstat jako pár po celý školní den, aby dokázali, že jsou si souzení, navzdory astrologické předpovědi pana Smalla.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Owen omylem spolkne žvýkačku, kterou ochutná poprvé v životě. Aby ochránil své kamarády před jistým výbuchem, odebere se na jejich radu do Žvýkačkové sopky a hodlá se vrhnout do jejího chřtánu.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Šéf varuje Beth a Codyho, aby nedělali obličeje před jeho zakletým zrcadlem, protože by jim tak mohly zůstat. To se i stane, jen úplně jinak, než si to všichni představovali.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Cody má novou robotickou panenku a myslí si, že je to jeho nejlepší kamarád. Ostatní děri ji rozbijí a musejí zachránit situaci.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Finn se přihlásí do turnaje ve střelbě z kuše, aby dokázal, jak je mužný; Jake se nemůže rozhodnout, jestli mu má říct, že mu to vůbec nejde.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Finn je zatažen do souboje mezi šlechtickými brouky a před velkým soubojem se musí naučit, jak se chovat ve vyšší společnosti.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Když Finn zjistí, že Jake zakopává láhve s démonickými kletbami na zahradě, musí svého kamaráda přesvědčit, aby se svým démonům postavil - doslova.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Když se Ledový král zamiluje do princezny, co ho zachránila, a žije v iluzi o jejich vztahu, musí mu Finn a Jake zabránit v tom, aby si ublížil.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Všichni předpokládají, že je vztah Darwina a Carrie odsouzený k záhubě, protože jsou každý tak jiný. Tedy všichni až na Darwina a Carrie. Když se pak na scéně objeví senzační bývalý přítel Carrie, donutí Gumball Darwina, aby oba k.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Anais a školní magor Jamie jsou obvinění ze stejného zločinu. Proto musí spojit síly a najít pravého pachatele a dokázat svou nevinu. Po vyřešení případu jim dojde, že mají víc společného, než si myslely.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite
programme.desc: Mladí Titáni do toho! je komediální pohled na život superhrdinů. Diváci dostanou možnost sledovat, jaký život má super mládež. Spolubydlící a superhrdinové Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy a Cyborg chrání město Jump City před padouchy. Teda když se zrovna nehádají a nesnaží navzájem trumfovat.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite
programme.sub-title: Titáni jdou do opravny, druhá část
programme.desc: Tým opravny je při snaze opravit Titánům vybavení hnán na hranici svých možností.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite! VIII
programme.desc: Lex Luthor unites the world's villains to capture all the superheroes. Lex Luthor spojí padouchy z celého světa, aby dopadl všechny superhrdiny. Poslední na jeho seznamu jsou DC Super Hero Girls.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite! IX

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin si předsevzali, že odnaučí Claytona lhát. O svém tajném kungfu hmatu ale Clayton nelhal a najednou je třeba řešit úplně jiný problém.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Šerif Kobliha přistihne Gumballa s Darwinem při přecházení na červenou a rozhodne se je za každou cenu přesvědčit, že být policistou je super.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama

programme.title: Totalna dramarama

programme.desc: Owen donese na svou prezentaci do školky humra. Díky tomu se děti dozví, že má Šéf pořádný humří problém.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Po polštářové bitvě u Darwina propukne silná alergie. Zatímco s Gumballem zjišťuje, co ji způsobilo, začíná být nebezpečný svému okolí.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Na svátek matek Gumball se spolužáky podrobí své mámy zkoušce, aby zjistili, která z nich je ta nejlepší na světě.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite! I
programme.desc: (Teen Titans Go! I) Neus-mond. Komičan kaos obilježen je psinama i povremenim borbama protiv zločina, no dotiče i svakodnevna pitanja odrastanja. Uz natjecanja u kojima gubitnici peru veš, pothvate izrade savršenog sendviča ili borbe protiv zločina u Jump Cityju, jedno je sigurno - ovi Titani uvijek su spremni... za pustolovinu, kod kuće i izvan nje.

programme.desc: Lady Duhorožka se snaží oživit herní večer princezny Žvýkačky, Marcelíny a princezny Halušky tím, že je vezme na epické RPG dobrodružství.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Ředitel Brown dá Gumballovi a Darwinovi starého školního křečka Chrise Morrise, aby se o něj přes víkend postarali. Oni ho však omylem nechají ve škole a místo něj si domů odnesou příčesek ředitele Browna. Překvapivě jim připadá ja.

programme.title: Redovita emisija
programme.desc: Rigby pokazí Maellardův oběd a nyní musí on nebo Benson napsat rezignační dopis.

programme.title: Redovita emisija
programme.desc: Margaret chce moderovat týdenník v místních večerních zprávách.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Když se Ledový král zamiluje do princezny, co ho zachránila, a žije v iluzi o jejich vztahu, musí mu Finn a Jake zabránit v tom, aby si ublížil.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball obdrží děsivý e-mail od strašlivého ducha a rozhodne se ho ignorovat navzdory Darwinově radě. Odmítá to přiznat, ale prokletí se stane skutečností a celou rodinu to vtáhne do jiné dimenze. Gumball a Darwin s pomocí Carrie ale rodi.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Babička Jojo si přivede na oslavu narozenin přítele a táta z toho není nadšený. Zakáže babičce, aby se s Louisem znovu viděla. Když děti přistihnou babičku, jak se pokouší proklouznout z domu, táta vyzve Louise, aby dokázal, kdo je jed.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Darwin se vypraví na půdu, kde hledají věci, které by se daly prodat při garážovém výprodeji, a narazí při tom na svoje staré hračky. Zvlášť Darwin má radost, když najde svoje staré loutky, Franka a Howdyho. Začne si s nimi.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Nicole, která už má dost ošklivých dárků od babi Jojo, popíchne děti, aby vzaly věci do svých rukou a "jako nehodu" rozbili škaredou vázu od Jojo. Když se ji však Gumball, Darwin a Anais snaží zničit, zjistí, že je odolnější, než v.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Když Darwin požádá Gumballa, aby ho naučil jezdit na skateboardu, Gumball se postará o to, aby se vyznal ve všech oblastech životního stylu skateboardingu - od správného oblečení přes správné výrazy až po výběr správného prkna. Jenž.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Lamput

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Když Gumball dostane prokletou herní konzoli, Elmore se stane součástí světa fantasy RPG hry. Gumball, Darwin a Anais si musejí probít cestu městem a odhalit tajemství nové virtuální reality. Musejí se nalevelovat, aby vůbec měli šanci pr.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Hektor je nešťastný ze svojí výšky, a tak kluci použijí jeden z lektvarů paní Jotunheimové, aby ho zmenšili, jenomže to dopadne katastrofálně.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumballův nepřítel Rob si přeje se ho jednou provždy zbavit, a tak divákům navrhuje celou řadu pořadů s jinými hlavními postavami, než je Gumball. Bohužel pro Roba je jeden horší než druhý.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.desc: Pro jednou je Gumball tím, komu by se ostatní měli omluvit.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Gumball a Penny spolu musí zůstat jako pár po celý školní den, aby dokázali, že jsou si souzení, navzdory astrologické předpovědi pana Smalla.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite! I
programme.desc: (Teen Titans Go! I) Toren van Kracht. Crtana serija koja se prikazuje već pet sezona, komedija s naglaskom na likove - temeljene na likovima iz DC stripova - i usmjerena na humor spašavanja svijeta i zajedničkog života tinejdžera bez nadzora odraslih. Komičan kaos obilježen je psinama i povremenim borbama protiv zločina, no dotiče i svakodnevna pitanja odrastanja. Uz natjecanja u kojima gubitnici peru veš, pothvate izrade savršenog sendviča ili borbe protiv zločina u Jump Cityju, jedno je sigurno - ovi Titani uvijek su spremni... za pustolovinu, kod kuće i izvan nje.

programme.title: Mali titani krenite
programme.desc: Starfire má nového mazlíčka, velmi nebezpečného parazita, ale jediný, kdo pojme podezření, je Robin.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Ten nejteplejší den v roce a rozbitá klimatizace vedou k vodní bitvě epických rozměrů, která rozhodne, kdo je vládcem zahradní hadice ve školce.

programme.title: Totalna dramarama
programme.desc: Cody byl svým zesnulým strýcem zvolen jako jediný dědic. Dědictví získá pouze když se svými přáteli zdolají počítačovou hru.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Lana Bradonja
programme.desc: Lana s Boem v Mlze nedůvěry pátrají po tom, co se stalo s červem, který loď vedl na Ztracený ostrov Titánů.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Običan crtić: Izgubljene snimke
programme.desc: Když Rigby sní příliš nezdravého jídla, vyhodí jeho tělo jeho vědomí. Rigby, Mordecai a Hops se vydají na výpravu vědomí získat zpět před západem slunce.

programme.title: Običan crtić: Izgubljene snimke
programme.desc: Mordecai a Rigby jsou dva nejlepší kámoši, kteří své problémy a obyčejné úkoly z jejich nudné práce převádějí do fantastické podoby. Seriál Normálka pojednává o každodenním životě dvou nejlepších kámošů Mordecaie (sarkastická sojka) a Rigbyho (hyperaktivní mýval), kteří jsou zaměstnáni jako správci v místním parku. Práce je to k uzoufání nudná, a tak oba kamarádi dělají všechno pro to, aby se jí vyhnuli. To však často vede k řadě pošetilých eskapád, a to ke značné nelibosti jejich šéfa Bensona (automat na žvýkačky) a kolegy Hopse (yeti), ovšem k velkému potěšení jejich (dalšího) šéfa Dědy (muž s hlavou ve tvaru lízátka).... Mezi jejich další spolupracovníky patří obtloustlý zelený mužík Mlátička a duch zvaný Plácač.

To však často vede k řadě pošetilých eskapád, a to ke značné nelibosti jejich šéfa Bensona (automat na žvýkačky) a kolegy Hopse (yeti), ovšem k velkému potěšení jejich (dalšího) šéfa Dědy (muž s hlavou ve tvaru lízátka).... Mezi jejich další spolupracovníky patří obtloustlý zelený mužík Mlátička a duch zvaný Plácač.

Crtana serija koja se prikazuje već pet sezona, komedija s naglaskom na likove - temeljene na likovima iz DC stripova - i usmjerena na humor spašavanja svijeta i zajedničkog života tinejdžera bez nadzora odraslih. programme.desc: Když se Ledový král zamiluje do princezny, co ho zachránila, a žije v iluzi o jejich vztahu, musí mu Finn a Jake zabránit v tom, aby si ublížil.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Finn a Jake musí pomoci Ledovému králi najít náhradní klíč od hradu poté, co ho omylem nahého přivolali do svého domku.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball se má sejít s Penny v nákupním centru, ale jde pozdě a cestou se ještě víc zdrží kvůli celé řadě nedorozumění. Gumball v tom má zmatek.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že Rob, který jim kdysi přísahal pomstu, se je už nějakou dobu snaží odrovnat.

programme.title: Redovita emisija
programme.desc: Mordecai a Margaret si spolu vyrazí po tom, co Rigby a Eileen jdou na ceremoniál předávání Donova černého pásku. Ale překvapí je romantické city.

programme.title: Redovita emisija VII
programme.desc: (Regular Show VII) Samo prijatelji Rigby i Eileen pozvane su na Donovu dodjelu crnog pojasa zbog koje se Mordecai i Margaret moraju družiti sami.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet
programme.desc: Wattersonovi se musí dostat s Anais do Daisylandu dřív, než zábavní park definitivně uzavřou.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: BMO se snaží dát dohromady dva brouky, ale Finn a Jake mu zhatí plány vlastními představami o romantice, čímž ohrozí rodící se milostný příběh.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije
programme.desc: Marcelína hodí Finnovi a Jakeovi na krk bytost z toaletního papíru, kteří jí musí najít nový domov dřív, než jim zničí ten jejich.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Wattersonovi se snaží Darwinovi připomenout jeho rybí kořeny. Když máma vidí, jak Darwin dlouze hledí do akvária, napadne ji, že životní styl savců jejího adoptivního syna nenaplňuje a v hloubi duše touží po návratu ke svým rybím ko.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Sdružení rodičů a učitelů z Elmorské osmiletky zakáže videohry, a tak se děti snaží dokázat, že na ně videohry nemají špatný vliv. Gumball zasvětí Billyho do světa videoher, ale ten z čiré radosti omdlí. Jeho matka Felicity svolá.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Gumball se urazí, když ho Tobias nepoplácá po zadku jako všechny ostatní. Tobias ke každému plácnutí rukou přidá plácnutí přes zadek, takže když Gumballa vynechá, ten se cítí dotčen. Celý den se snaží, aby ho Tobias plácnul po zad.

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet
programme.desc: Anais ve svém pokojíku najde nepořádek jako po vloupání a zjistí, že její plyšák Daisy zmizel. Dojde jí, že hlavními podezřelými jsou Gumball s Darwinem. Jediná možnost, jak odhalit, co se stalo s Daisy, je zahájit důkladně vyšetřov.

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov predivno pomaknuti svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Gumballov čudesni svijet

programme.title: Vrijeme je za avanturu: Sporedne misije

programme.title: Novi Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Potěšte se novou populární sérií animovaných grotesek, které navazují na milované postavy Looney Tunes a přinášejí vám neuvěřitelně bláznivá dobrodružství, která si zamiluje celá rodina. Nejdříve si králíček Bugs a kačer Daffy v Nejlepších kámoších vyzkoušejí své přátelství v soutěžní hře. Když Bugse a Daffyho chytí při dělání nepořádku, zjistí Krimipták a krimikrálík, že se jim život v base líbí. V Pouze pro členy Bugs a Daffy předstírají, že patří do exkluzivního country klubu, kde Bugs potká nádhernou... ale strašně užvaněnou... králici Lolu, která se do něj šíleně zamiluje. Výpadek proudu pak nakonec v epizodě Sousedská výpomoc přivede do jejich domu souseda Yosemite... Sama a díky jeho výbušné povaze začnou lítat jiskry. A jiskry se změní v ohňostroj legrace ve videoklip ech, v nichž účinkují marťan Marvin, Yosemite Sam a další hvězdy.

programme.title: Tom i Jerry
programme.desc: Kdo by je neznal? Protřelý kocour Tom a chytrý myšák Jerry se vracejí v novém kabátě. Legendární kámoši jak hrom se vrací v Show Toma a Jerryho, novém zpracování animované klasiky. Nový seriál si zachovává stejný vizuál, postavy i citlivost originálu a může se pochlubit zářivě barevnými taškařicemi ve vysokém rozlišení a nikdy nekončící válkou, která z Toma a Jerryho učinila nejmilovanější televizní postavičky všech dob. Ve dvou 11minutových dílech budou proti sobě kocour Tom a myšák Jerry kout pikle v jejich starém známém domově na předměstí, ale dočkáme se také dalších... příběhů, ve kterých se tito dva rivalové dostanou na zajímavější fantastická místa, například na středov ěký hrad nebo do laboratoře šíleného vědce. Co všechno se může stát ve zdánlivě jednoduchém příběhu, kde kocour honí myšáka a ten pak vrací úder? Možnosti jsou nekonečné.

programme.title: Gospodin Bean: Crtana serija

programme.title: Gospodin Bean: Crtana serija

programme.title: Novi Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Potěšte se novou populární sérií animovaných grotesek, které navazují na milované postavy Looney Tunes a přinášejí vám neuvěřitelně bláznivá dobrodružství, která si zamiluje celá rodina. Nejdříve si králíček Bugs a kačer Daffy v Nejlepších kámoších vyzkoušejí své přátelství v soutěžní hře. Když Bugse a Daffyho chytí při dělání nepořádku, zjistí Krimipták a krimikrálík, že se jim život v base líbí. V Pouze pro členy Bugs a Daffy předstírají, že patří do exkluzivního country klubu, kde Bugs potká nádhernou... ale strašně užvaněnou... králici Lolu, která se do něj šíleně zamiluje. Výpadek proudu pak nakonec v epizodě Sousedská výpomoc přivede do jejich domu souseda Yosemite... Sama a díky jeho výbušné povaze začnou lítat jiskry. A jiskry se změní v ohňostroj legrace ve videoklip ech, v nichž účinkují marťan Marvin, Yosemite Sam a další hvězdy.

programme.title: Gospodin Bean: Crtana serija II
programme.desc: (Mr. Bean: The Animated Series II) Lord Bean Lord Bean. Dok traži hranu po supermarketu, dugogodišnji prijatelj g. Beana, njegov Medo, postaje žrtva otmice. Bean kreće u potragu za zločincem i otkriva da Medo nije jedina žrtva. G. Bean spašava stotine medvjedića nakon što im uši prođu kroz industrijsku šivaću mašinu.

programme.title: Tom i Jerry
programme.desc: Kdo by je neznal? Protřelý kocour Tom a chytrý myšák Jerry se vracejí v novém kabátě. Legendární kámoši jak hrom se vrací v Show Toma a Jerryho, novém zpracování animované klasiky. Nový seriál si zachovává stejný vizuál, postavy i citlivost originálu a může se pochlubit zářivě barevnými taškařicemi ve vysokém rozlišení a nikdy nekončící válkou, která z Toma a Jerryho učinila nejmilovanější televizní postavičky všech dob. Ve dvou 11minutových dílech budou proti sobě kocour Tom a myšák Jerry kout pikle v jejich starém známém domově na předměstí, ale dočkáme se také dalších... příběhů, ve kterých se tito dva rivalové dostanou na zajímavější fantastická místa, například na středov ěký hrad nebo do laboratoře šíleného vědce. Co všechno se může stát ve zdánlivě jednoduchém příběhu, kde kocour honí myšáka a ten pak vrací úder? Možnosti jsou nekonečné.

programme.title: Novi Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Potěšte se novou populární sérií animovaných grotesek, které navazují na milované postavy Looney Tunes a přinášejí vám neuvěřitelně bláznivá dobrodružství, která si zamiluje celá rodina. Nejdříve si králíček Bugs a kačer Daffy v Nejlepších kámoších vyzkoušejí své přátelství v soutěžní hře. Když Bugse a Daffyho chytí při dělání nepořádku, zjistí Krimipták a krimikrálík, že se jim život v base líbí. V Pouze pro členy Bugs a Daffy předstírají, že patří do exkluzivního country klubu, kde Bugs potká nádhernou... ale strašně užvaněnou... králici Lolu, která se do něj šíleně zamiluje. Výpadek proudu pak nakonec v epizodě Sousedská výpomoc přivede do jejich domu souseda Yosemite... Sama a díky jeho výbušné povaze začnou lítat jiskry. A jiskry se změní v ohňostroj legrace ve videoklip ech, v nichž účinkují marťan Marvin, Yosemite Sam a další hvězdy.
