programme.title: Crna lista
programme.desc: Jednotka stále truchlí nad ztrátou Liz, Reddington se však vrací v plné síle a sdělí jim jméno ženy, která byla objednána k únosu Liz. Jmenuje se Susan Hargraveová a rozhodně se nechce nechat chytit ani čelit Redovi, ten však hodlá využít všechny své prostředky, aby ji našel a zjistil, kdo jí za únos Liz zaplatil. Vyšetřovací tým FBI se snaží identifikovat ženu, se kterou se setkal Stadler. Red je informuje, že jde o Susan Hargraveovou. Ta se svým manželem vlastní korporaci, která oficiálně poskytuje bezpečnostní služby. Podle Reda je to soukromá vojenská zpravodajská agentura. Díky odposlechům vyjde najevo, že Susan měla provést jen únos Liz Keenové, nikoliv však její smrt. Zadavatelem této zakázky byl muž, v jehož jméně jedná právě Stadler. Protože Susaniny lidé únos pokazili a ona zemřela, nabízí... Susan Stadlerovi jako omluvu, že se sejde s Reddingtonem a zastřelí ho.

programme.title: Vatreni dečki
programme.desc: "Brownies" (August 3, 2011)The guys from 62 Truck watch the report on 9/11, in which Tommy is prominently featured. They show him citing the 343 figure of firefighter dead, and Tommy saying it's also the greatest rescue in the history of the New York Fire Department.Tommy says Jimmy was a great hero and explains that after rescuing people from one of the towers, he then went into the other tower to help there. Sheila is shown saying she's comforted knowing he died helping people."So far so... good," Needles says.The report moves on to Damian, and shows him in the chair. Tommy says he's blames himself for what happened to Damian, but not what happened to Jimmy.We see the reporter ask him what would have been a happy ending to that story. Tommy says everybody dies.She says that day made FDNY firefighters known for being heroes. Tommy says they don't need a spotlight, they're just doing their jobs.Then he goes on, saying that they get paid "bleep.""And here we go..." Lou says, watching.Tommy tells the reporter to back off. She asks about alcohol and drug abuse, allegations of racism. Tommy cites the minority members of their crew and says firefighters don't go into a building and ask where the white people are. He gets angry and starts cussing."Nobody gives a f--- what color people are, as long as they're made out of steel," he rants.He complains that he's tired of them being talked about like they're glorified garbage men. He keeps swearing, cusses her out, takes off his microphone and storms off, flipping the camera off on the way."So it seems the pain of 9/11 still runs deep," she says, closing her report, adding that firefighters like Tommy aren't taking advantage of the department's counseling.When it's over, Franco is instantly mad at Tommy for making them all look bad. Then he turns on Needles, asking him why he wasn't able to talk the reporter out of using that footage like he promised.Franco swears at Needles and Needles charges him. The guys intervene.Everybody's phone rings.Needles yells at Franco, calling him "pretty boy" and telling him his stuff ends now. Needles leaves and Franco is still mad as hell, telling Tommy it's his fault he just got in a fist fight with a commanding officer. He promises that footage will go viral.Tommy asks what he's worried about. Franco lists Tommy's resume, drinking, sleeping with Sheila. Tommy asks if he's worried they'll find out he was spouting 9/11 conspiracy theories, or, Tommy says, that he tried to sleep with his wife.Then Franco rushes Tommy and they have to be broken up.Franco tells Lou that if he was in charge he'd do a better job keeping Tommy in line.Later, Lou reads a cookbook, telling Tommy he's preparing for his second career in case he needs one.Janet and Sheila both call Tommy, on his side and piling on the reporter. Sheila says at least people will remember Jimmy. Janet has a long list of grocery items they need. Kelly calls and he switches over.Kelly hasn't heard about her test results yet. She tells him to call her later.Lou hears him on the phone with her. Tommy says it's not what he thinks. Lou tells Tommy he's better off just sleeping with her and avoiding an emotional affair.Mike and Shawn put down a deposit for a wedding space. Mike assures him it's great. Colleen arrives with Teddy and loves it immediately. They discuss music. Shawn wants a DJ. Colleen and Mike were thinking string quartet. Teddy insists there be bagpipers to play "Here comes the Bride," a Gavin tradition.The woman who owns the space hears they're Irish and immediately tells them to get out. "This place means too much to me to have another McGuire Incident," she says.Teddy actually knows what she's referring to. He says they make the Gavins look Irish. He apologizes to the woman and gives her another $400 to keep, for "reparations."Sean finishes up his date with the dress shop woman, Emily. They agree the date went well. He kisses her good night and puts her in a cab, promising to call her. Instead, she drags him into the cab and gives the driver her address.Cut to them in bed. The date is still going well.When they're finished, Sean cuddles up to her but smells something foul. He looks around and sees her small dog.Kelly calls Tommy. She tells him her news was good and she's done with treatment. She asks him to come over, and to bring milk, butter and eggs. Somehow he's found another woman who needs groceries.Sean meets Mike in a bar. Sean tells him he had the best date ever with her and then the best sex of his life. But then after he smelled a stench so foul it was like a "sewer in a bad neighborhood where people only eat Indian food."Sean says it wasn't him. "I have never in my life farted the smell of a rotten corpse," he says.Mike asks if she has a dog.Sean says the dog was tiny, but Mike thinks they may have just traumatized it with their sexual activity.Tommy arrives at Kelly, with groceries.She's making pot brownies as a thank you for the friend who let her stay in the apartment. Tommy shows her the flowers he brought.Tommy tells her he's overwhelmed with estrogen and that his daughter is getting married. He's creeped out that she's having sex with someone he works with, but Kelly assures him that'll stop soon after they get married. He's oddly comforted.Kelly goes to check on her brownies and finds she's burned them. She freaks out, throwing plates and breaking glasses. Tommy doesn't know what to do, but she yells at him that it's not about the brownies.Her doctor told her she won, but she doesn't feel like she won anything. She keeps throwing stuff and then yells that she's sorry.She regroups, explaining that she went through everything and doesn't know where to go next. She lays on the floor and tells Tommy she wishes she had a real boyfriend to do this with.He helps her up and hugs herHe tells her as she was ranting, he was thinking about "her eyes and her ass." He kisses her.He asks if she feels better. She says somewhat, but asks him if he thinks his kisses work magic.She surveys the damage and says it helped her focus. In 10 years, she doesn't want to be Tommy. She tells him the booze and women don't matter, he should still just go home to his wife and kiss her the way he just kissed Kelly.She asks him to leave.Franco meets with Chief Feinberg in the city and tells him he wants to be a lieutenant. Feinberg says if Franco aces his test, he'll call downtown and make sure he's assigned to a top house in the city. He just tells him to keep his nose clean and mouth shut.Sean and Emily have more mind-blowing sex. He rolls over to cuddle with her, but the smell comes back. Sean looks around for the dog, but she says he's at her sister's for the night. Sean buries his face in the pillow.Later, in the SUV on the way to a scene, Needles diagnoses that Sean's dating a farter. When Sean tells him she's the most beautiful woman he's ever seen, Needles tells him to quit complaining.At the fire, Shawn tells Mike the clovers on Colleen's dress were a nice touch. Tommy pushes ahead to knock down a door first. The other guys turn around as Tommy plows through.He swings out over and empty space. There's nothing beyond the door but steep drop off, and a fire down below. The building ends.Outside, Needles sends Shawn to look over a wall and he finds the building is only held up with bracing. He radios a mayday telling the guys to get out.They try to shout to Franco, but he busts through a door on the other side of the shaft and ends up barely hanging on over the flaming chasm below. They get a ladder put it horizontally across the opening and Tommy climbs over the flames below to get Franco, who's struggling to hang on.Tommy gets below Franco and holds onto him. He drops down to the ladder and they both crawl to safety.Outside, Franco thanks Tommy. He shakes his hand, but tells Tommy it doesn't change anything about the other thing. Franco elaborates that he means how Needles, Lou and Tommy are crashing the crew into the ground.

programme.title: Vatreni dečki
programme.desc: Tommy finds Feinberg and Needles reading headlines about Tommy's blow up in the news feature.People from FD HQ are there. Feinberg tells Tommy they're going to let him play in the police-firefighter hockey game and he should be grateful he gets at least that.The supervisor gives Tommy notice that he's suspended for 30 days. They want his badge, ID and bunker gear. He also has to be escorted in and out of the building during that time. Tommy tries to stall, but they are insistant.He's goes... upstairs to get his stuff, but can't help piling on one of the supervisors who used to be a working fi reman in front of the guys. The supervisors inform the guys anyone who assists Tommy in entering the fire house could get suspended or fired.When they leave, Franco says they get to find out what they're like without him. He's also heard that the TV reporter is looking into all their personal lives, thanks to Tommy.Outside, Tommy taunts the supervisors as they leave. Pam Kepler has been camping outside of HQ for weeks and is looking into Tommy's personal life.Needles tells Tommy to lie low. When Tommy says he's not afraid of the reporter, Needles says it's not about just him. They recite the various skeletons in their closet: Needles married a mail order bride, Lou married a hooker, Sean married a Gavin. There's Mike's gayness and Franco's conspiracy theories, and he could be considered a deadbeat dad.Then Mike mentions his "extreme gayness" and offers that he once hooked up with a guy at headquarters. Lou thanks god in heaven for the gift.Mike doesn't remember his name at first, but settles on Doug. Then he says he looked like a young Michael Douglas. Needles wants Lou to find photos.Needles tells Tommy to go home and not do anything stupid for a month. He starts to assign Franco a task, but Franco doesn't want to be part of it. He walks away.Needles asks Black Shawn to call Pam and tell her someone is spouting 9/11 conspiracy theories. Shawn doesn't want to rat on Franco, but Needles says he's talking about himself.Sean finishes up another great date with Emily, but he pauses when she asks if he wants to come upstairs. "You look like you're holding something in," she tells him.He says he has something a little embarrassing to say. He explains that after they have the best sex he's ever had in his life...She asks if he's talking about the smell. "It's my butt," she says.He asks if she's OK. She tells him the physiological explanation behind it and then says it's a good thing he has a small penis or it'd be way worse. Somehow, they regroup and he goes upstairs with her. But he just wants to cuddle.Mike looks at pictures of Dougs at HQ, but none of them are his Doug. He describes how he had a beauty mark and was masculine and feminine.The next day, Needles goes to talk to the news crew. He chats up the camera man, who says he's just doing his job and has an uncle in the department. When Needles says he knows him, he offers to get him his uncle's number.Needles talks to Pam, who has already figured out his ruse that he was pretending to be the conspiracy nut to draw attention from his men. She knows it was the "handsome guy with dimples." And she knows Tommy slept with Sheila for years and Janet had a son with Tommy's dead brother.Needles calls her a "miserable bitch" and starts to walk away. The cameraman calls him back and gives him a card (it says his name is Peter Tolan, which is the name of the show's co-creator). On the back is scribbled "Keppler DUI."Needles meets with Tommy and catches him up on Mike's not-Doug. He says he looked into Pam's DUI and there's no record of it, which makes him think the cops know something. He tells Tommy to talk to Todd, the cop he's always fighting with in hockey games. Needles tells him to do whatever he needs to get the info. Then he makes it more clear: Tommy has to throw the hockey game.Tommy finds Todd outside the police station. He tells him what Pam's planning and asks if he has any info. He offers to throw the game. Todd curses him out and walks away.At a bar after the game, Lou gives Tommy the name of Mike's hook up, telling him to do with it what he will.Someone makes a toast to the tie game. They salute each other, until a firefighter gets up and says it's too bad 9/11 wasn't a tie because 343 firefighters died, and only 23 cops. A brawl breaks out.Tommy sees Todd signaling him to meet him outside. Tommy comes out with his dukes up. Todd tells him he got info on Pam and introduces Larry "Lochness" from another precinct. He tells her he pulled over Pam a year or so ago and she was completely coked up. She got out of it by performing the title of the episode on him. He has video. He shows Tommy, who is impressed. "Now you know why they call me 'Lochness,'" he says.Todd says Pam's a hypocrite and should be taken down.Todd says they're doing it for Johnny, their fellow former police officer. Then Todd decks Tommy for good measure.Cops pull up outside. Teddy comes out, explain that he called them because the cops are getting their butts kicked inside and he thought they needed back-up.Tommy comes home to find Colleen shrieking and Katie piling on. Katie says she's getting made fun of at school because Tommy's her dad.Colleen's mad because wedding venues keep canceling on her when they learn he's her dad. Tommy gets things thrown at him.Sheila offers to pay for a better place, but Janet says no.Sheila tells Tommy about expensive mansions she knows about in Connecticut in New Jersey that she wants to rent. She wants to pay for the whole thing, but Janet says that's wrong since Sheila won't even be involved. She's refusing to go if Mickey is there and Janet thinks he has to be.Colleen thinks they're trying to make her start drinking again. She goes for the liquor cabinet. There's lots of shrieking of women. Tommy pounds a book to get everyone's attention.Tommy asks Sheila how much money they're talking about. She says $8,000. For just the dress. Now Tommy wants a drink.Wyatt interrupts things by coming in crying.Tommy sends Sheila and Janet to their separate corners. He tries to lay down the law. He says Sheila will be in the wedding. He also says Mickey was right, Damian won't ever walk again and was right to say it to her. Then he tells Janet that Sheila is paying for the wedding, but he'll pay her back someday.The girls come back in. He says they're a dysfunctional family of drinkers, addicts, liars and cheaters and it's gotten them nowhere.He tells them he has a "secret evil plan" to combat the truth people are looking into and it involves playing to their strengths of lying, cheating and stealing.Tommy tries to tell Sheila again that she has to accept that Damian is never getting out of the chair, and he's telling her that because he loves her.Then he tells Janet that as much as he loves Sheila, he loves her more. He kisses her deeply. He calls Sheila to come with him so he can outline her part in the evil plan.Cut to Sheila pulling up to HQ, where Pam is prepping for air outside. Sheila sits down for her interview. Pam puts on her serious face and asks what happened after 9/11. Sheila asks if she's asking about Tommy.Then Sheila says they had lots of mind blowing sex, because they could. And every time, it at least helped Sheila not think about her dead hero husband for awhile. She says she has video and takes out her phone. She puts the phone in front of the camera and plays and we hear Lochness's voice saying Pam's name and telling her to do things.Pam panics.Sheila tells her to sit. "You drop that story or I swear to Christ that'll end up on YouTube," Sheila says. She gets up and runs back to her car.Next, she goes to HQ with a bouquet of flowers.She meets with the supervisors who suspended Tommy. They talk up Jimmy to her, but tell her her "boyfriend" is a "scourge" on the department. One of them says if he has his way, Tommy will get fired.The third man, whose office they're in, comes in. His friends call him Doug. Sheila hands him the flowers and says they're from Mike Siletti. Then she taps a secret panel to open a liquor cabinet.She pours herself a drink and asks if having booze is against regulations, just like having sex in there after hours.Then Sheila goes in his desk and finds the handcuffs Mike told her about.Outside, she calls Tommy, telling him "Doug" is fired, Pam keeps calling to offer her money to delete the video and Tommy is back on duty.He thanks her, but she says she did it for "all of us.""For the brotherhood?" he asks."No silly, for the Gavins," she says.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Při pátrání po pašerákovi drog Van Bergenovi pomáhají dálniční policii i celníci, pro které pracuje Benova nová láska Nina. Van Bergen zatím dlouho beztrestně unikal, protože má někde mezi celníky informátora.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Případ podivné vraždy zavede Bena a Semira do malé vesnice v Eifelu, kde se seznámí s venkovským policistou Manfredem Scholzem. Manfred je mladý, sympatický nekňuba, kterého nikdo ve vsi nebere vážně. Ben se Semirem ho přesto přiberou při vyšetřování do party. Manfred postupně ukáže všem, že se v něm mýlili. Semirova žena Andrea má narodeniny, Semir si kvôli tomu vzal voľno, ale oslava dopadne inak, než si predstavoval. Andrei príde do mobilu správa od akéhosi Roberta, ktorá potvrdzuje Semirove podozrenie, že jeho žena má milenca. Nemá čas to ale riešiť, pretože vzápätí sa aj so svojím parťákom Benom ponáhľa na pomoc architektke Katharine Wendtovej, ktorú z jej domova uniesla skupina ozbrojených mužov. Semir sa následne zapletie do zložitého teroristického prípadu, pričom narazí na svojho... dávneho parťáka Andrého Fuxa, o ktorom bol presvedčený, že je dávno mŕtvy. André ale v skutočnosti prežil a začal pracovať ako tajný agent pre Spolkový kriminálny úrad.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Semir prožívá těžké období. Opustila ho totiž jeho milovaná žena Andrea, která odešla i s dětmi. Brzy ale přichází na jiné myšlenky. Na dálnici je s Benem svědkem, jak tragicky zahyne novinář Feldmann. Vše ale nasvědčuje tomu, že jeho smrt nebyla nehoda. Semir prežíva ťažké obdobie. Opustila ho totiž jeho milovaná žena Andrea, ktorá odišla aj s deťmi. Čoskoro ale prichádza na iné myšlienky. Na diaľnici je s Benom svedkom, ako tragicky zahynie novinár Feldmann. Všetko ale nasvedčuje tomu, že jeho smrť nebola nehoda.

programme.title: Gorski liječnik
programme.desc: Dramatické a emocionální příběhy o horském lékaři Martinovi Gruberovi v idylickém Ellmau u Wilder Kaiser. Příběh lékaře, který se ožení s dcerou horského zvěrolékaře, ale odmítne praxi v alpské vesnici a jde za kariérou do Mnichova. Nešťastnou náhodou přijde jeho manželka při autonehodě o život a tchán mu tuto událost dává za vinu. Dojde k rozkolu, který vyústí téměř ze strany zvěrolékaře (tchána) v nepřátelství. Usmíření těch dvou zařídí hospodyně zvěrolékaře a přiláká zetě lékaře, aby začal praxi u nich na horách. Vlivem laviny přijde lékař o život a místo něj nastoupí nový mladý lékař a... vesnice tak konečně získala opět svého lékaře, který poskytuje všestranné služby obyvatelům hor tak, jak je to běžné odjakživa u venkovských lékařů.

programme.title: Hamburg 112
programme.desc: Nové případy na sebe nenechávají dlouho čekat a hamburští policisté mají opět plné ruce práce. Tým hamburských policistů se v práci rozhodně nenudí. Parťáci Melanie Hansenová s Nilsem Meermannem se zrovna zabývají případem malého chlapce Louise, který se kvůli bití bojí přijít domů s pololetním vysvědčením. To, že je doma týrán, zjistila náhodou Nilsova přítelkyně lékařka Anna. Z týrání syna je podezřelý jeho přísný otec Georg. Je to však opravdu tak, jak to vypadá? Franzi Jungová je na místním oddělení nová. Její nadřízený Berger ji musí zpočátku uklidňovat, protože vztah s jejím... parťákem, poněkud svérázným Bojem Thomfordem, není zrovna ideální. Zejména poté, co se Franzi bezelstně snaží smířit Bojeho s jeho otcem Hubertem. Boje se s ním vůbec nestýká a zrovna mu odmítne půjčit peníze, aby mohl pozvat na malou oslavu své přátele bezdomovce..

programme.title: Hamburg 112
programme.desc: Franzi freaks out abysmally when her kid daughter Emma, walking her first day alone to school, goes missing, like her cellphone. Companion classmate Jule claims she saw Emma step into a strange car, but father Dr. Philipp Jung gets her to confide that was just a guilty lie for parting after a fight. Emma's phone is found, with the fingerprints of ex-con child abuser Jan Koopmann, whose claim to be fully reformed is proven by a solid alibi. Emma's school stuff is found, not the bag, but she... was also seen stealing a rabbit from a pet shop's snake food cage.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Státní zástupkyně dala svou dceru na praxi k dálniční policii. Šestnáctileté dívce to připadá jako hrozná nuda, dokud ovšem nezažije s Benem a Semirem divokou honičku na dálnici. Když hlídka objeví pronásledovanou dodávku, které se v honičce podařilo ujet, je prázdná. Najdou v ní ale zakrvácenou bundu, která patří pohřešovanému chlapci, který byl podle rodičů unesen. Heike-Maria, dcera obávané státní zástupkyně Schrankmannové, chce být také státní zástupkyní, a proto nastoupila na školní praxi u dálniční policie. Šéfka Krügerová ji hodila na krk Semirovi a Benovi. Ti jsou z horlivé puberťačky upřímně nešťastní do té doby, než jim pomůže vyřešit případ únosu několika mladistvých tím, že poslouží policii jako volavka.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Jejich revírem je dálnice. Jejich tempo je vražedné. Jejich protivníky jsou překupníci kradených aut, vrahové a vyděrači. Muži z Kobry 11 pracují ve dne v noci. Jejich úkolem je chránit naši bezpečnost.. Frank Stolte a Ingo Fisher jsou původní kolegové v tomto seriálu. Ve druhé epizodě však Ingo umírá a nastupuje pozdější ikona seriálu, Simir Gerkhán. Od druhé série dostává Simir nového parťáka, Andrého Fuxe, spolu pronásledují zločince cca ve 40 epizodách, potom André umírá na Mallorce při nebezpečné akci, v epizodě Osamělé vítězství. Od 4 řady má Simir tak nového kolegu, Toma Kranicha, poprvé se objevuje v pilotním filmu k nové řadě, Pekelná jízda po dálnici A4. Nastává tak nová éra Kobry,... která se stává více akčnější a scény jsou více přitažené za vlasy. Na konci 6 řady Tom seriál opouš tí a nastupuje Jan Richter. Po dvou řadách však i on končí a od 9 řady se vrací na scénu Tom Kranich. Ale i to není stále konec rošády, v první epizodě 11 řady Tom Kranich umírá. Nahrazuje ho Chris Ritter, kterého hraje Gedeon Burkhard.

programme.title: Navy CIS
programme.desc: Tým šetří případ, ve kterém je poručice námořnictva Rachel Donahueová obviněna z pokusu zavraždit svého manžela. Žena ale tvrdí, že vůbec neví, že muže napadla. Zprvu jí agenti nevěří, ale když při vyšetřování omdlí, ukáže se, že jí kdosi bez jejího vědomí do těla implantoval zařízení na podávání léků. Dvaja muži so zbraňami v rukách sa vlámu do domu, keď zrazu cez zábradlie prepadne muž so slučkou okolo krku. Vyšetrovatelia neskôr zistia, že obeťou je psychológ Robert Banks, ktorý pracoval pre Pentagón. Jeho ošetrujúca lekárka, Dr. Rachel Cranstonová, je presvedčená, že muž sa nezabil sám. Žil pre svoju maloletú dcéru Amber. Pracoval na špeciálnom projekte pre Pentagón a Cranstonová sa domnieva, že jeho smrť súvisela s touto úlohou.

programme.title: Navy CIS
programme.desc: Seriál vypráví o každodenní práci týmu speciálních agentů pod vedením zkušeného vyšetřovatele Leroye Jethro Gibbse, který musí vyřešit jakýkoliv zločin týkající se zaměstnanců vojenských námořních sil. Tým zvláštních agentů, kteří operují mimo vojenské velení, musí vyšetřit každý zločin, který má něco společného s námořními silami, bez ohledu na to, jakou hodnost mají podezřelí. Vede je zvláštní agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs, který vedle racionálních úvah vždy dá i na své instinkty.

programme.title: FBI: Najtraženiji
programme.desc: Tým sleduje dva bratry, kteří se rozhodli pomstít členům společnosti, která způsobila zničení životního prostředí v jejich městě. Sarah se také setkává s ostatními členy rodiny LaCroixových, včetně Jessiny sestry Louise. FBI rieši prípad dvojnásobnej vraždy. Obeťami sú vodič nákladného auta Teddy Burdette a jeho manželka Janice, ktorých telesné pozostatky sa našli v ich vlastnom vozidle zmrzačené a podivne naaranžované. Je to nejaký odkaz? A čo ním chceli páchatelia povedať? Stopy naznačujú, že manželia mohli byť zapojení do rozsiahlej trestnej činnosti. Medzitým Sarah prijíma pozvanie na večeru a spoznáva členov rodiny agenta Jessa LaCroixa. Prípady špeciálnej jednotky FBI, ktorá pátra po najhľadanejších... zločincoch Spojených štátov. Tím, ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix. C ieľom federálnych agentov je dopadnúť extrémne nebezpečných kriminálnikov, ktorí si vyslúžili svoje miesto na zozname najhľadanejších zločincov Spojených štátov. Tím, ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix.

programme.title: FBI: Najtraženiji
programme.desc: Případy speciální jednotky FBI, která pátrá po nejhledanějších zločincích Spojených států. Tým, který pracuje jako tajná vládní jednotka, vede agent Jess LaCroix. Akční kriminální seriál sleduje práci členů speciální jednotky FBI, která pátrá po největších zločincích na útěku. Cílem federálních agentů je dopadnout extrémně nebezpečné kriminálníky, kteří si vysloužili své místo na seznamu nejhledanějších zločinců Spojených států.

programme.title: Zakon i red: Odjel za žrtve
programme.desc: Jeden z nejúspěšnějších amerických seriálů, kde skvělý vyšetřovací tým řeší netradiční případy. Spin-off jednoho z nejdelších a nejúspěšnějších krimiseriálů nejen společnosti NBC, Law & Order. Myšlenka původního seriálu, tedy rovnocenné rozdělení dílu na část detektivní a část soudní, se posouvá ve prospěch práce vyšetřovatelů, i když divák si užije i charizmatických státních zástupců. Special Victims Unit neboli Útvar pro zvláštní oběti je zvláštní oddělení NYPD, které se zabývá řešením případů násilných trestných činů se sexuálním motivem. V Law & Order: SVU ale nejsou hlavní zločiny... ani jejich pachatelé. Jsou to muži a ženy s odznakem, kteří se snaží žít své normální životy a chrá nit svoje blízké před zvěrstvy, která vidí při své práci dnes a denně.

programme.title: Zakon i red: Odjel za žrtve
programme.desc: Jeden z nejúspěšnějších amerických seriálů, kde skvělý vyšetřovací tým řeší netradiční případy. programme.title: Crna lista
programme.desc: Jeden z nejhledanějších zločinců světa se nechá zatknout přímo v sídle FBI. Raymond Reddington, kterému se přezdívá Red, tvrdí, že mají společné zájmy - tedy polapit nebezpečné zločince a teroristy. FBI souhlasí se spoluprácí, ale Reddington trvá na tom, že chce mluvit pouze s mladou Elizabeth Keen. Raymond pomáhá polapit obávaného teroristu a FBi se rozhodne pokračovat ve spolupráci. On sám pak vysvětluje, že posledních 20 let dával dohromady svůj vlastní seznam nebezpečných teroristů a... zločinců. Pojmenoval ho Blacklist. Raymond "Red" Reddington, jeden z nejhledanějších zločinců, se nechá dobrovolně zatknout v sídle FBI. Tvrdí, že FBI a on mají stejné zájmy, polapit nebezpečné zločince a teroristy. Reddington souhlasí se spoluprací, ale trvá na tom, že bude mluvit jen s agentkou Elizabeth Keen, nováčkem FBI. Reddington o agentku projevuje nebývalý zájem a tvrdí, že je velmi výjimečná. Reddington pomůže agentům polapit obávaného teroristu a díky tomu agentura souhlasí se vzájemnou spoluprací. Raymond... vysvětluje, že za posledních 20 let si dělal svůj seznam nejnebezpečnějších zločinců a teroristů, o kterých neví ani samotná FBI. Řiká mu Blacklist.

programme.title: Vatreni dečki
programme.desc: Feinberg, Lou and Needles check out Ground Zero with Tommy. They get lunch after. Lou mentions that it's a shame there's no public memorial.Feinberg tells a story about losing 10 of his men in Vietnam and going to visit the memorial and feeling nothing. Instead, he takes out photos of his men from his wallet. He remembers details about each of them. He also had a letter from one of the men. Many of the firefighters on 9/11 wrote letters as went down to the Twin Towers. He says talking... about the fallen is a better way to memorialize them.At Sheila's, Tommy stands watch over Damian. He sees a picture Sheila has of her and Jimmy. Tommy starts going through their photo album. He finds a letter to her. It says "Happy Anniversary, to the love of my life."Tommy puts it back. When he looks up, Damian is no longer in his chair. He goes looking for him in the apartment. He picks up a bat, just in case. In the living room, he sees Damian with a letter. Damian talks to him, telling him that letter is the one he's looking for. Jimmy left it in a book at the house.Tommy starts reading from it. It's heartfelt and emotional, Jimmy saying he loves her madly and deeply. As he's reading it, Sheila comes home and sees him. She shrieks at him and tells him to get out. We see that Tommy nearly ransacked the place looking for it.Back in the kitchen, there's a vodka bottle out. Tommy swears he hasn't been drinking. Sheila smells his breath and smells nothing. She gives him the bottle of booze and tells him she doesn't trust him around Damian anymore. He tells her he went to the 9/11 memorial and it must have triggered something. He apologizes.Tommy is baffled. He asked Sheila if she ever told him about the letter. She says she did, five years ago, when they had that insane night on the beach. He doesn't remember any of it.Sheila's angry because the letter was the only part of Jimmy that she got to keep entirely to herself. She says it's evidence of the deepest connection she ever had with anyone and Tommy has crossed a dangerous line. She tells him to leave.The guys all listen to Sean finish a story. Lou sums it up: "So your girlfriend is a farter?" Sean objects to the "f" word. Mike calls her a "fartress." Mike brings him an oxygen mask and tank.They get a call to a gas leak. "We're going over to Garrity's girlfriend's place?" Black Shawn says, as the jokes continue on the rest of the ride.At the townhouse, they go in and smell something, but not gas. They find a man on the couch, not responding. When they get closer they see why. It's a dad with his two kids. Tommy checks for pulses and finds none.The ride back is decidedly more somber. Nobody says anything.Back home, Tommy goes to check on Wyatt late at night. He looks in on Janet and the girls. He gets worried and goes to inspect. They wake up and tell him to get out.Sean and Emily finish up in bed. She rolls over to light a cigarette. When she rolls back we see Sean has strapped on the gas mask. She's cool with it.Sheila, Mike, Colleen and Shawn check out one of the mansions. Colleen worries about the expense. Sheila tells her she's not going to throw anymore money away on miracle cures for Damian. She tells Colleen to accept the wedding on his behalf.Sheila tells Colleen that she wants this for her because marriage is really hard and she'll want that one day to look back on and be happy all over again. Then she adds she has no idea what she's talking about, she had her reception at the VFW.Tommy comes in to the locker room to find Lou trying to look at a spot on his back. He thinks it's a boil and wants Tommy to look because he's his best friend. Tommy determines it'll involve pus at some point. Then, on the friend front, he tells Lou he wrote some letters to his family in case he is killed in the line of duty. He gives them to Lou and tells him not to read them.Tommy gives him another stack, with letters for just about everyone else he knows. He checks again that Lou knows no one is supposed to read them.Cut to Lou reading the letter to him from Tommy. It starts out talking about him as a great friend. Then it says: "You fat, undisciplined piece of s---...." And blasts him for not waiting to read his letter. Then he mentions red velvet cupcakes he has hidden under his bed and tells Lou not to touch them. Lou doesn't read the rest of the letter and goes immediately for the cupcakes.When he comes up from under the bed, Tommy is there waiting for him. Tommy yells at him for being impatient, but Lou turns around on him and tells him he's tired of all his 9/11 talk. Ever since then Lou's been eating to feel better and Tommy's been drinking -- Lou saw the bottle of vodka in the back of his truck. He says they're zombies, already dead. He tells Tommy to go bury himself in the hole downtown to make it official that he's victim number 344.Tommy walks away. Lou follows Tommy out with the cupcakes. The guys all see him with the cupcakes and ride him. Shawn asks him if he put through his vacation days.Lou forgot.He tells them he's been going to culinary school and got straight As. He takes out his report card to prove it, but Shawn grabs it and sees that it's all dessert classes.Franco announces that between that and forgetting Shawn's paperwork it's the "straw that broke the Puerto Rican's back."Lou asks Franco if he thinks he could do better. "If I don't have to bake cupcakes at the same time, yea," Franco says.Lou turns to Needles and asks if he can turn over the keys to the kingdom. Needles says Franco can be acting lieutenant for five days, but all decisions have to go through him. Lou hands over his keys.Franco checks out the office. It's a paperwork nightmare.Down at Ground Zero, Tommy sits in his truck and guns the engine, aiming for the hole. He opens the bottle of vodka. He's about to take a swig when he sees people running out of the subway and debris in the sky. He's picturing 9/11. He sees Jimmy carrying a woman out and crashing noises and debris falling from the sky. He sees a body land on his car.He wakes up with a start.A bum asks him for a dollar, then sees him and asks if he's OK. Tommy gives him his bottle of booze.

programme.title: Vatreni dečki
programme.desc: Lou saunters in to work to see a spotless firehouse. Mike and Sean are busy cleaning. Franco, the new temporary boss, greets them, telling them they're late. He tosses Lou's cigar away. He tells Lou his fitness regimen is posted in his locker.Franco tells Tommy to get in his station gear. They haven't had many real calls yet, but Franco has done ridealongs.Tommy has more letters for Lou to give to people after he dies. He apologizes for baiting Lou and tells him about going down to... Ground Zero and thinking about driving into the hole. He doesn't want to be No. 344. He tells Lou the letters are full of his inner "stuff."Tommy leaves to get coffee and Lou lurks, waiting for him to come back and check on him.Tommy comes home to find the women laughing it up with Teddy. Sheila leaves and everyone gets quiet.Janet asks him to go to one meeting a day from now until the wedding and not go to Ground Zero again. And he has to promise not to freak out at the wedding. Colleen tells him Teddy is walking her down the aisle in her $10,000 dress.Teddy gets the girls and leaves, telling Janet to consider Plan B.When they leave, she tells Tommy that Plan B is Tommy doesn't go to the wedding. She tells him it's been five months since he went to a meeting.Janet wants him to talk to Mickey about performing the ceremony and to get into a safe job off the rig. She wants proof he's going to meetings every day. He promises he'll be sober for the ceremony to walk Colleen down the aisle.Tommy goes to a meeting led by Mickey. Tommy raises his hand to interrupt. Mickey tells Tommy he's not going to the wedding. He starts yelling at Tommy that he's never going to be in the same room with Sheila again. Tommy asks him to sign his form, but gets yelled at instead.Lou sits down with Tommy's letter in his hands. He opens it.Tommy talks about Lou being a true brother to him and says he trusts him to look after his family now that's he gone. He tells Lou that he's the bravest man he's ever known and all of his own bravery came from knowing Lou was there supporting him. Lou gets choked up.Tommy comes in to work and Franco immediately rides him for not being in uniform. Lou comes in the kitchen and Tommy's on a non-stop rant about how everyone's mad at him. Lou just stares at Tommy weirdly. The alarm sounds.They ride out to the waterfront, where a car is teetering half off the edge. Franco wants to get the driver out immediately, but Lou shouts at him that they need the chain on the car so it doesn't go over.Franco goes for the driver and the car immediately starts to tip off the edge. They manage to hold it long enough for Tommy to hook the hose underneath. They use the truck to pull the car back.Franco, realizing he was wrong, tries to talk to Lou, but Lou tells him he shouldn't have tried to be a hero to save face and that a good lieutenant never would have made that call. Lou says when they get back to the house, he's taking his title back.Tommy smiles smugly and tells Franco that he's A-Rod and Lou is Jeter, and he goes for the win instead of the glory. Franco accuses Tommy of going for the glory. Needles tells him that Tommy understands there is none.Lou pays Sheila a visit. He takes out a bottle of vodka and pours a shot. He lights it, saying that's how Tommy sees it. He says booze it like fire to him and when he poured the shot that night, he went to the dark place and started rummaging for information.Lou says the darkness is also where Tommy's best instincts reside. He takes out photos of people Tommy has saved, including a woman he carried down ten flights down and revived on the sidewalk. He says the list has at least 35 people on it because of Tommy. He lights each on fire in the flaming vodka to make his point.Finally, he takes out Damian's picture, saying Tommy saved him before his latest accident. He takes out Sheila's picture and says Tommy saved her from herself, just by being there.He tells her about the letters Tommy has written to everyone. He says they're only supposed to read them if Tommy dies. He gives her her letter and confesses he read his already. He says it was the first time he thinks Tommy's ever been honest about their friendship.Lou says if he's Jeter, Tommy is Mickey Mantle. He packs up his booze. Sheila tells him to leave it, but he confesses it's lighter fluid, because he wanted that eternal flame effect. Lou urges her to give Tommy another shot.Lou leaves. She immediately opens Tommy's letter.He says he cannot express what their time together was worth. He chooses some meaningful words: love, lips, heat, hope. He says she gave him hope and he'll always be with her. Then he adds a rambling p.s. about some wine he found in her closet. It brings her to tears.Lou is giving the same shot-on-fire spiel to Janet, complete with photos. She worries about the fire but he proceeds with the demonstration, tossing the lit photos into the sink. He keeps talking but Janet notices the sink flaming behind him. He knocks over his lighter fluid demonstration, and fire spreads across the kitchen. Then it catches Lou's shirt on fire.Janet grabs a fire extinguisher and puts it out. All she cares about with Tommy and his job is that he quits.Tommy enters the rehearsal dinner. Shawn introduces him to his brothers, D'brickashaw, Maliq and José.Needles looks at Tommy deeply and finally hugs him and kisses him. When he walks away, Mickey comes over and says hi. Tommy doesn't know what he's doing there.Tommy joins Janet, who is all smiles and kisses him.Colleen stands up to make a toast to Shawn. She also toasts Tommy, and tells him she loves him and thanks him.Janet goes back to staring at Tommy with puppy dog eyes. He can't figure out what's going on.Then Needles gets up and toasts Tommy, saying he's the best firefighter, friend and dad. Then Mickey toasts Tommy, too.Finally, Tommy stands up and asks everyone what's going on. People are being suspiciously nice to him. He asks if he has cancer or if someone's going to shoot him again.Janet explains that Lou handed out all of his letters and she told everyone about his promise: to retire from the fire department.She thanks him for typing it so she could read it. Tommy asks who else got a letter. Five hands go up.Tommy asks Lou to join him outside.Lou tells him about giving Sheila his and accidentally lighting Janet's on fire, so he had to recreate it on a typewriter saying things he thought Janet would want to hear from Tommy. Then he cracked under the responsibility and gave everyone theirs, except "the regular guys."Lou tells Tommy he thinks he really should quit.Tommy freaks, saying he can't pay for the $10,000 dress with no job. He thought he gave Lou a simple task. Lou says he wanted to help, to do something Tommy can't: express how he feels.He wrote what he thought Tommy would want to say to Janet.Tommy says he broke a sacred bond, Lou tells him again to quit and think about other people. Tommy works to contain his rage.He tells Lou he's not Jeter, he's Judas.Lou points out that would make Tommy Jesus.Tommy storms back inside."Don't think I'm not coming in for dessert," Lou says, "'cause I am!

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Státní zástupkyně dala svou dceru na praxi k dálniční policii. Šestnáctileté dívce to připadá jako hrozná nuda, dokud ovšem nezažije s Benem a Semirem divokou honičku na dálnici. Když hlídka objeví pronásledovanou dodávku, které se v honičce podařilo ujet, je prázdná. Najdou v ní ale zakrvácenou bundu, která patří pohřešovanému chlapci, který byl podle rodičů unesen. Heike-Maria, dcera obávané státní zástupkyně Schrankmannové, chce být také státní zástupkyní, a proto nastoupila na školní praxi u dálniční policie. Šéfka Krügerová ji hodila na krk Semirovi a Benovi. Ti jsou z horlivé puberťačky upřímně nešťastní do té doby, než jim pomůže vyřešit případ únosu několika mladistvých tím, že poslouží policii jako volavka.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Jejich revírem je dálnice. Jejich tempo je vražedné. Jejich protivníky jsou překupníci kradených aut, vrahové a vyděrači. Muži z Kobry 11 pracují ve dne v noci. Jejich úkolem je chránit naši bezpečnost.. Frank Stolte a Ingo Fisher jsou původní kolegové v tomto seriálu. Ve druhé epizodě však Ingo umírá a nastupuje pozdější ikona seriálu, Simir Gerkhán. Od druhé série dostává Simir nového parťáka, Andrého Fuxe, spolu pronásledují zločince cca ve 40 epizodách, potom André umírá na Mallorce při nebezpečné akci, v epizodě Osamělé vítězství. Od 4 řady má Simir tak nového kolegu, Toma Kranicha, poprvé se objevuje v pilotním filmu k nové řadě, Pekelná jízda po dálnici A4. Nastává tak nová éra Kobry,... která se stává více akčnější a scény jsou více přitažené za vlasy. Na konci 6 řady Tom seriál opouš tí a nastupuje Jan Richter. Po dvou řadách však i on končí a od 9 řady se vrací na scénu Tom Kranich. Ale i to není stále konec rošády, v první epizodě 11 řady Tom Kranich umírá. Nahrazuje ho Chris Ritter, kterého hraje Gedeon Burkhard.

programme.title: Gorski liječnik
programme.desc: Dramatické a emocionální příběhy o horském lékaři Martinovi Gruberovi v idylickém Ellmau u Wilder Kaiser. Příběh lékaře, který se ožení s dcerou horského zvěrolékaře, ale odmítne praxi v alpské vesnici a jde za kariérou do Mnichova. Nešťastnou náhodou přijde jeho manželka při autonehodě o život a tchán mu tuto událost dává za vinu. Dojde k rozkolu, který vyústí téměř ze strany zvěrolékaře (tchána) v nepřátelství. Usmíření těch dvou zařídí hospodyně zvěrolékaře a přiláká zetě lékaře, aby začal praxi u nich na horách. Vlivem laviny přijde lékař o život a místo něj nastoupí nový mladý lékař a... vesnice tak konečně získala opět svého lékaře, který poskytuje všestranné služby obyvatelům hor tak, jak je to běžné odjakživa u venkovských lékařů.

programme.title: Hamburg 112
programme.desc: Shortly after his harbor bar is badly vandalized by goons, Tarik has to fish the lease holder, recently paroled Horst Ruhland, from the Elbe which he was thrown in from a yacht trailing to the owner, who wants him out, but Horst refuses to testify before or in hospital. Ruhland had been jailed for shooting former crime mate Alex Konz but still maintains being framed by the same, yet can't remember what actually happened that evening. Wolle researches their theory Konz and his slick lawyer... Christian Teuber want the bar back as part of a development project. Constable Claudia's son Max Fisch er was Ruhland's cellmate, now works as his barman and is committed to help prove his innocence and build a future together, to Claudia's pointless frustration, helped by Tauber's daughter Anna, and he gets arrested in the process. Franzi's husband files for custody after she failed to mind Emma, so she plans to fight that and resign her job.

programme.title: Hamburg 112
programme.desc: Shortly after just released petty ex-con Mustafa Erbil is denounced as Syria jihad volunteer without evidence by his sister Emine, he's wounded in a street fight and refuse sto talk, only Tariq wins some confidence by proving hiself a better Muslim. * Suspects include a former cellmate and a dealer, after an episode.with flushed drugs, but mainly German convert-recruiter Gerd "Jassir" Molsen, who paid Mustafe for weapons. Tarik Molsenstarts questioning everything and comes up with an... unsettling plot and culprit.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: Případ podivné vraždy zavede Bena a Semira do malé vesnice v Eifelu, kde se seznámí s venkovským policistou Manfredem Scholzem. Manfred je mladý, sympatický nekňuba, kterého nikdo ve vsi nebere vážně. Ben se Semirem ho přesto přiberou při vyšetřování do party. Manfred postupně ukáže všem, že se v něm mýlili. Po rozchodu s Andreou je Semir úplně vykolejený. I přes špatný psychický stav je nasazen na pátrání po Paulu Mainhardtovi, odsouzenému za vraždu své přítelkyně. Paul uprchl z vězení, aby na svobodě mohl dokázat svou nevinnu. Obrátí se o pomoc na svého bývalého spoluvězně Alexe Brandta. Brandt je policista, který byl po dvou letech ve vězení rehabilitován a má se stát novým kolegou Semira. Paul se mezi tím uchyluje k zoufalému činu a unáší výletní loď s pasažéry. Za jejich propuštění... požaduje, aby policie obnovila vyšetřování jeho případu a usvědčila skutečného viníka.

programme.title: Navy CIS
programme.desc: Seriál vypráví o každodenní práci týmu speciálních agentů pod vedením zkušeného vyšetřovatele Leroye Jethro Gibbse, který musí vyřešit jakýkoliv zločin týkající se zaměstnanců vojenských námořních sil. Tým zvláštních agentů, kteří operují mimo vojenské velení, musí vyšetřit každý zločin, který má něco společného s námořními silami, bez ohledu na to, jakou hodnost mají podezřelí. Vede je zvláštní agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs, který vedle racionálních úvah vždy dá i na své instinkty.

programme.title: Navy CIS
programme.desc: Seriál vypráví o každodenní práci týmu speciálních agentů pod vedením zkušeného vyšetřovatele Leroye Jethro Gibbse, který musí vyřešit jakýkoliv zločin týkající se zaměstnanců vojenských námořních sil. Tým zvláštních agentů, kteří operují mimo vojenské velení, musí vyšetřit každý zločin, který má něco společného s námořními silami, bez ohledu na to, jakou hodnost mají podezřelí. Vede je zvláštní agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs, který vedle racionálních úvah vždy dá i na své instinkty.

programme.title: FBI: Najtraženiji
programme.desc: Jess a tým Most Wanted míří do Tennessee, aby vypátrali tajného agenta DEA, který se zdá být zapletený do rozsáhlé operace proti drogovému kartelu. Sarah si navíc klade otázku, zda bylo chybou nastěhovat se k Jessovi a Tali tak brzy. Špeciálna jednotka FBI, ktorá pátra po najnebezpečnejších zločincoch na úteku, sa vydáva do Tennessee. Jej cieľom je tentoraz Clayton Smith, tajný agent protidrogovej jednotky DEA, ktorého podozrievajú, že zradil a počas veľkej operácie proti drogovému gangu prešiel na stranu zločinov. Agent sa vyparil z povrchu zemského a zanecháva za sebou mŕtve telá. Ale je Clayton skutočne zradca a odpadlík? Sarah Allenová, priateľka veliteľa špeciálnej jednotky Jessa La Croixa, medzitým uvažuje, či... neurobila chybu, keď sa tak rýchlo nasťahovala k Jessovi a jeho dcére Tali. Prípady špeciálnej jednotky FBI, ktorá pátra po najhľadanejších zločincoch Spojených štátov. Tím, ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix. Cieľom federálnych agentov je dopadnúť extrémne nebezpečných kriminálnikov, ktorí si vyslúžili svoje miesto na zozname najhľadanejších zločincov Spojených štátov. Tím, ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix.

programme.title: FBI: Najtraženiji
programme.desc: Místní případ newyorské pobočky FBI, který se týkal dvou zavražděných žen a několika vlivných mužů, se náhle promění v pátrání po nebezpečném vůdci rozsáhlé zločinecké skupiny. Do případu, který vyšetřují speciální agenti FBI Maggie Bellová a Omar Zidan z New Yorku, se zapojí také speciální tým FBI pod vedením Jessa La Croixe, který pátrá po nejnebezpečnějších zločincích na útěku. Lokálny prípad newyorskej pobočky FBI, ktorý sa týkal dvoch zavraždených žien a niekoľkých vplyvných mužov, zrazu prerastie do pátrania po nebezpečnom vodcovi rozsiahlej zločineckej skupiny. Do prípadu, ktorý vyšetrujú špeciálni agenti FBI Maggie Bellová a Omar Zidan z New Yorku, sa zapojí aj špeciálny tím FBI pod vedením Jessa La Croixa, ktorý pátra po najnebezpečnejších zločincoch na úteku. Prípady špeciálnej jednotky FBI, ktorá pátra po najhľadanejších zločincoch Spojených štátov. Tím,... ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix. Cieľom federálnych agentov je dopad núť extrémne nebezpečných kriminálnikov, ktorí si vyslúžili svoje miesto na zozname najhľadanejších zločincov Spojených štátov. Tím, ktorý pracuje ako tajná vládna jednotka, vedie agent Jess LaCroix.

programme.title: Zakon i red: Odjel za žrtve
programme.desc: Jeden z nejúspěšnějších amerických seriálů, kde skvělý vyšetřovací tým řeší netradiční případy. Spin-off jednoho z nejdelších a nejúspěšnějších krimiseriálů nejen společnosti NBC, Law & Order. Myšlenka původního seriálu, tedy rovnocenné rozdělení dílu na část detektivní a část soudní, se posouvá ve prospěch práce vyšetřovatelů, i když divák si užije i charizmatických státních zástupců. Special Victims Unit neboli Útvar pro zvláštní oběti je zvláštní oddělení NYPD, které se zabývá řešením případů násilných trestných činů se sexuálním motivem. V Law & Order: SVU ale nejsou hlavní zločiny... ani jejich pachatelé. Jsou to muži a ženy s odznakem, kteří se snaží žít své normální životy a chrá nit svoje blízké před zvěrstvy, která vidí při své práci dnes a denně.

programme.title: Zakon i red: Odjel za žrtve
programme.desc: Monica pracuje jako striptérka. Krátce před Vánoci najde při odchodu z práce kolo, na kterém do baru jezdí, v nepojízdném stavu. Následně vše nahlásí na policejní stanici. Nikdo ji ale zpětně nekontaktuje, a tak dívka vyvěsí po okolí plakáty, na nichž veřejně oznamuje, že byla znásilněna.

programme.title: Crna lista
programme.desc: Reddington dá agentům FBI najevo, že jejich spolupráce asi brzy skončí. Liz je po smrti a on je jim v podstatě k ničemu. Pan Kaplan opatruje Toma i Agnes, protože po nich jdou Kirkovi muži. S jeho pomocí se Tomovi i Agnes podaří uprchnout z USA na Kubu. To ale rozzuří Reddingtona. Red i FBI je Alexanderu Kirkovi stále blíž. Kaplan opatruje Toma i Agnes, protože po nich jdou Kirkovi muži. Tomovi se s pomocí Kaplana podaří i s Agnes uprchnout z USA na Kubu. To ale rozzuří Reda, protože zjistí, že ho Kaplan vlastně zradil. A navíc Toma i Agnes pronásleduje na Kubu i Kirk. Kaplan prozradí Reddingtonovi, že Liz je pořád naživu, že s její smrt byla nahraná proto, aby byly Liz i Agnes chráněny před ním samotným. Reddington cestuje na Kubu, zde ale najde pouze prázdnou vilu a... poházený nábytek.

programme.title: Lick Like Lesbians
programme.desc: Those warm summer evenings bring out the adventurous side in you. Watch Bailey Ryder & Bella Baby enjoy the warmth of the sun and of eachothers beautiful bodies.

programme.title: The Dark Hour
programme.desc: The eight years boy Jesús has been living in a crumbling underground facility since he was born with eight survivors of an apocalyptical war: the leader Maria and her lover Pablo; the gays Lucas and Mateo; the astronomer Magdalena and the teenager Ana; the soldier Pedro and the lonely Judas. They are permanently is state of surveillance, threatened by the contaminated mutants The Strangers and once a day they have to lock themselves in their rooms without heating to protect against the... dangerous ghosts The Invisibles that attack in the Cold Hour. They cannot go to the surface, destroyed by a nuclear war. When they need supplies, medications and ammunitions, they organize expeditions to a store. When the menace of The Invisibles affects the safety of the group of survivors, they need to reach the surface.

programme.title: Završni Snimak
programme.desc: Jeff is a photographer entrusted with an antique camera. Looking through his shots one day, he finds one of a beautiful, sad-faced woman. It's a wonderful shot, but he didn't take it. It brings him acclaim, along with problems whe..

programme.title: Fraternity
programme.desc: Two new university students enter an initiation game to join an exclusive fraternity, but things quickly spiral out of control as the initiation proves far more dangerous than expected.

programme.title: Dete sa jezera
programme.desc: A pregnant woman returns to the lake house where her first son drowned. As her due date nears, she becomes convinced he has come back, and that he does not want a brother.

programme.title: They Buried
programme.desc: Five miners buried in a gallery 600 meters deep.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Elisabeth meets the love of her life on her bachelorette night, and the weekend they spend together is the beginning of the end.

programme.title: Love in Paradise
programme.desc: Invited by her son on a trip to the Caribbean, a single mother is stunned to discover it's actually a matchmaking retreat, where new connections spark and love takes her by surprise.

programme.title: Loving Cuba
programme.desc: While a mother only just finds out that her daughter's dating a Cuban, she realises her daughter will get married on Cuba too. To hinder the failure-designated marriage, she immediately gets on a flight to Cuba.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Evelyn, dospívající dívka z Peru, cestuje do Španělska s příslibem práce servírky. Zdrogovaná, unesená a pod výhružkou smrti je přinucena pracovat jako sexuální otrokyně v bordelu.. Dospívající Evelyn by určitě nevadilo zůstat na venkově v Peru, kde je doma. Její rodina není příliš bohatá, ale zvládá vyžít i s omezeným příjmem. Je to její matka, kterou okouzlila žena z agentury, jež už pomohla její sestřenici Margaritě se přestěhovat do Španělska. Pod tlakem rodiny a uklidněna telefonátem Margarity se Evelyn rozhodne využít příležitosti... jenže vše se změní v děsivou noční můru. Když přijede do Španělska, nenachází zářnou budoucnost, ve kterou doufala, ale matoucí svět... bordelu, ve kterém najde Margaritu zmučenou dlouhými měsící prostituce a strachem. Donutili ji, aby Evelyn přesvědčila k přestěhování a zamlčela jí pravdu. Eveleniny vyhlídky jsou pochmurné - znásilnění a drogy jsou hlavními prostředky majitele bordelu Ricarda, jenž se snaží jí zlomit, aby mu vydělala peníze, které mu údajně dluží.

programme.title: Oslobođena
programme.desc: Trojici vysoce postavených lidí, která si vyrazila na lovecký víkend, postihne nehoda. Panika vyústí ve špatná rozhodnutí a právě tehdy začíná opravdový lov. Překročte hranici, odkud už není návratu - některé věci se totiž nedají odpustit. Tři profesně úspěšní a zdánlivě šťastní lidé vyrazí na víkend do hor, kde se chtějí věnovat lovu a celkově se trochu pobavit. István - stavební magnát, Márta - jeho právnička a László - právniččin manžel čekají, že si užijí pár pohodových dní mimo město. To se ale škaredě pletou. Poté, co tragická nehoda zapříčiní smrt jednoho z místních, vezme počáteční klid rychle za své. Postupně začne vycházet najevo, že má každý z nich svůj vlastní plán, a tajemství z dávné minulosti promění bývalé... kamarády v nepřátele a ze starých nepřátel možná naopak udělá spřízněné duše. V obležení skalnatých vrch olů a na míle daleko od civilizace se probouzejí divoké, odvěké instinkty - a každý může spoléhat jen sám na sebe..

programme.title: Hortense
programme.desc: An apparently well-rounded woman hides a secret wound: her daughter Hortense was taken from her as she was only 3. An apparently ordinary woman hides a secret heartbreak: her daughter Hortense was snatched from her when she was only three. It's a trauma that's haunted her for 20 years, until she meets a woman in her 20s, an orphan looking for her origins, and recognizes her as her long-lost daughter.

programme.title: Nepristojnost
programme.desc: Mo a její nejlepší kamarádka jsou během zkoušky přistiženy při podvádění tím nejpřísnějším profesorem ze školy. Když ho Mo požádá, aby jí dal druhou šanci, profesor pozve obě dívky k sobě domů, kde budou muset projít nečekanou zkouškou. Vysokoškolačky Mo a Vera jsou kamarádky už od dětství. Moin otec zemřel, když byla ještě v pubertě, ale ona se dodnes nedokáže se svou ztrátou vyrovnat. Během zkoušky přistihne Ursu, jeden z nejpřísnějších profesorů ze školy, Mo při podvádění. Ta mu ovšem začne vzdorovat a tak jí Ursu zabaví mobilní telefon a vyhodí obě dívky ze zkouškové místnosti. Odpoledne Ursu dívkám zavolá a pozve je do restaurace, aby jim zabavený mobil vrátil. Studentky budou muset projít nečekanou zkouškou. Všichni... se skvěle baví, dokud se ovšem Mo nepřestane ovládat.

programme.title: Loving Cuba
programme.desc: While a mother only just finds out that her daughter's dating a Cuban, she realises her daughter will get married on Cuba too. To hinder the failure-designated marriage, she immediately gets on a flight to Cuba.

programme.title: They Buried
programme.desc: Five miners buried in a gallery 600 meters deep.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Evelyn, dospívající dívka z Peru, cestuje do Španělska s příslibem práce servírky. Zdrogovaná, unesená a pod výhružkou smrti je přinucena pracovat jako sexuální otrokyně v bordelu.. Dospívající Evelyn by určitě nevadilo zůstat na venkově v Peru, kde je doma. Její rodina není příliš bohatá, ale zvládá vyžít i s omezeným příjmem. Je to její matka, kterou okouzlila žena z agentury, jež už pomohla její sestřenici Margaritě se přestěhovat do Španělska. Pod tlakem rodiny a uklidněna telefonátem Margarity se Evelyn rozhodne využít příležitosti... jenže vše se změní v děsivou noční můru. Když přijede do Španělska, nenachází zářnou budoucnost, ve kterou doufala, ale matoucí svět... bordelu, ve kterém najde Margaritu zmučenou dlouhými měsící prostituce a strachem. Donutili ji, aby Evelyn přesvědčila k přestěhování a zamlčela jí pravdu. Eveleniny vyhlídky jsou pochmurné - znásilnění a drogy jsou hlavními prostředky majitele bordelu Ricarda, jenž se snaží jí zlomit, aby mu vydělala peníze, které mu údajně dluží.

programme.title: The Dark Hour
programme.desc: The eight years boy Jesús has been living in a crumbling underground facility since he was born with eight survivors of an apocalyptical war: the leader Maria and her lover Pablo; the gays Lucas and Mateo; the astronomer Magdalena and the teenager Ana; the soldier Pedro and the lonely Judas. They are permanently is state of surveillance, threatened by the contaminated mutants The Strangers and once a day they have to lock themselves in their rooms without heating to protect against the... dangerous ghosts The Invisibles that attack in the Cold Hour. They cannot go to the surface, destroyed by a nuclear war. When they need supplies, medications and ammunitions, they organize expeditions to a store. When the menace of The Invisibles affects the safety of the group of survivors, they need to reach the surface.

programme.title: Dete sa jezera
programme.desc: A pregnant woman returns to the lake house where her first son drowned. As her due date nears, she becomes convinced he has come back, and that he does not want a brother.

programme.title: Love in Paradise
programme.desc: Invited by her son on a trip to the Caribbean, a single mother is stunned to discover it's actually a matchmaking retreat, where new connections spark and love takes her by surprise.

programme.title: Fraternity
programme.desc: Two new university students enter an initiation game to join an exclusive fraternity, but things quickly spiral out of control as the initiation proves far more dangerous than expected.

programme.title: Horizont
programme.desc: Rodina začne podnikat hluboko v horách na Západě Rumunska, kde si otevře penzion s názvem Horizont. Zanedlouho si však uvědomí, že všechno, co se v horách odehrává - včetně jejich života - ovládá Zoli se svým zločineckých gangem. Po mnoha letech práce v zahraničí zkusí manželé Lucian a Andra hledat štěstí hluboko v horách na západě Rumunska, kde se ukryjí v odlehlé chatce. Všechno jde zdánlivě bez problémů, dokud si neuvědomí, že cokoli, co se v horách odehrává - včetně jejich života - ovládá Zoli, zločinec zapletený do nezákonné těžby dřeva. Rodina se i se svým penzionem Horizont brzy ocitne v konfliktu jak s muži zákona, tak i místní mafií.

programme.title: Alpsko skijanje: Svetski kup, Gurgl, slalom za žene, prva vožnja
programme.desc: FIS Svjetski kup u alpskom skijanju međunarodno je natjecanje najviše razine u alpskom skijanju, koje od 1967. organizira Međunarodna skijaška i snowboard federacija (FIS). Okuplja najbolje svjetske alpske skijaše i skijašice koji predstavljaju nacionalne saveze, a tijekom zimske sezone obuhvaća utrke spusta, superveleslaloma, veleslaloma i slaloma u velikim planinskim skijalištima diljem Europe, Sjeverne Amerike i drugih regija. Natjecatelji se utrkuju na vrijeme i prikupljaju bodove na... temelju ostvarenog plasmana. Odvojeni ukupni poredci i poredci po disciplinama za muškarce i žene određ uju pobjednike Svjetskog kupa u pojedinoj sezoni, kojima se dodjeljuju prestižni kristalni globusi.

programme.title: Skijaški skokovi: Svetski kup u Lilehameru, žene HS 140, 1. dan
programme.desc: Svjetski kup u skijaškim skokovima godišnja je serija međunarodnih natjecanja u zimskim sportovima koju organizira Međunarodna skijaška i snowboard federacija (FIS). Okuplja najbolje skijaše skakače i skakačice svijeta na skakaonicama u više zemalja. Utemeljena je 1979. godine, a natjecanja za žene uvedena su 2011. godine. Obuhvaća pojedinačna i ekipna natjecanja na skakaonicama normalne i velike veličine te na letaonicama. Skokovi se ocjenjuju prema duljini, tehnici i prilagodbama za... vremenske uvjete, a bodovi prikupljeni tijekom sezone određuju ukupne pobjednike Svjetskog kupa u muškoj i ženskoj konkurenciji.

programme.title: Konjički sport: Globalna liga šampiona, Verona, Skakanje, Finale
programme.desc: Global Champions Tour elitna je međunarodna serija natjecanja u preponskom jahanju kategorije CSI s pet zvjezdica za pojedinačne jahače i konje, koju je 2006. osnovao olimpijski prvak Jan Tops. Jahači skupljaju bodove za prvenstvo na natjecanjima Grand Prix koja se održavaju diljem svijeta, a najbolji rezultati ulaze u ukupni poredak sezone. Svako natjecanje Grand Prix u pravilu se odlučuje u jednom krugu, nakon kojeg se po potrebi održava baraž. Format je znatno izmijenjen 2017., kada je... uvedena i Global Champions League kao zasebno ekipno natjecanje, dok je Global Champions Tour ostao po jedinačno prvenstvo.

programme.title: Powerlifting: Svetsko prvenstvo u opremljenoj otvorenoj kategoriji 2026, Istanbul, Pregled
programme.desc: Svjetsko prvenstvo IPF-a u powerliftingu s opremom u otvorenoj kategoriji godišnje je međunarodno natjecanje u sportu snage koje organizira Međunarodna powerlifting federacija (IPF), a okuplja vodeće sportaše i sportašice iz cijeloga svijeta. Natjecatelji se uz odobrenu potpornu opremu natječu u tri discipline: čučnju, potisku s klupe i mrtvom dizanju. U svakoj disciplini imaju pravo na tri pokušaja. Najveće uspješno podignute težine zbrajaju se u ukupni rezultat, a pojedinačne titule... svjetskih prvaka dodjeljuju se u osam muških i osam ženskih težinskih kategorija.

programme.title: Snuker: Open Velike Britanije, finale: Mark Selby - Jak Jones
programme.desc: British Open profesionalni je bodovni turnir u snookeru u sklopu World Snooker Toura. Prvi je put održan 1980., a status rangirnog turnira stekao je 1985. Nakon 2004. uklonjen je iz kalendara, da bi ponovno bio pokrenut 2021. Turnir je poznat po prepoznatljivom sustavu nasumičnog ždrijeba, pri čemu se parovi ponovno izvlače nakon svakog kola umjesto da slijede unaprijed određenu turnirsku shemu. Pobjednik dobiva Trofej Clivea Evertona.

programme.title: Skijaški skokovi: Svetski kup, Lilehamer, Norveška, Muškarci HS 140, 2. dan
programme.desc: Svjetski kup u skijaškim skokovima godišnja je serija međunarodnih natjecanja u zimskim sportovima koju organizira Međunarodna skijaška i snowboard federacija (FIS). Okuplja najbolje skijaše skakače i skakačice svijeta na skakaonicama u više zemalja. Utemeljena je 1979. godine, a natjecanja za žene uvedena su 2011. godine. Obuhvaća pojedinačna i ekipna natjecanja na skakaonicama normalne i velike veličine te na letaonicama. Skokovi se ocjenjuju prema duljini, tehnici i prilagodbama za... vremenske uvjete, a bodovi prikupljeni tijekom sezone određuju ukupne pobjednike Svjetskog kupa u muškoj i ženskoj konkurenciji.

programme.title: Snuker: Šon Marfi - Vu Jize, Svetsko prvenstvo 2026 u Šefildu, Finale, 4. sesija
programme.desc: Svjetsko prvenstvo u snookeru najvažniji je godišnji profesionalni turnir u snookeru, koji organizira World Snooker Tour (WST) prema pravilima Svjetskog udruženja profesionalnih igrača biljara i snookera (WPBSA). Prvenstvo je utemeljeno 1927. godine, a od 1977. održava se u kazalištu Crucible u Sheffieldu u Engleskoj. Na njemu sudjeluju 32 igrača koji se natječu po sustavu izravnog ispadanja, uz sve dulje mečeve u svakom sljedećem kolu, sve do finala koje se igra na 18 dobivenih frameova od... najviše 35. Kao jedan od prestižnih turnira Trostruke krune u snookeru, uz Prvenstvo Ujedinjenog Kra ljevstva i Masters, turnir donosi bodove za svjetsku rang-listu i odlučuje o profesionalnom svjetskom prvaku te tradicionalno označava završetak sezone snookera.

programme.title: Trejl trčanje: Golden Trail World Series 2026, pregled sezone
programme.desc: Serija planinskih utrka koje okupljaju najbolje trkače planinskog trčanja na svijetu. Natjecanje nudi sportske izazove i impresivne lokacije na različitim mjestima diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Snuker: Kajren Vilson - Džad Tramp, Šangaj Masters, Finale
programme.desc: Shanghai Masters profesionalni je pozivni turnir u snookeru u sklopu World Snooker Toura, koji se održava u Šangaju u Kini. Prvi je put održan 2007. kao bodovni turnir, a 2018. postao je pozivni turnir koji se ne boduje za svjetsku ljestvicu. Danas okuplja elitna 24 igrača, među kojima su vodeći profesionalci sa svjetske ljestvice, kineski igrači i sudionici s posebnom pozivnicom. Turnir se igra po sustavu izravnog ispadanja, a mečevi u kasnijim kolima postupno su sve dulji te završavaju... produženim finalom.

Natjecanje se sastoji od četiri pojedinačna natjecanja, u Oberstdorfu, Garmisch-Partenkirchenu, Innsbrucku i Bischofshofenu, koja se boduju i za Svjetski kup.

programme.title: Snuker: Yuan Sijun - Wu Yize, Šenzen Open, finale, druga sesija
programme.desc: Shenzhen Open profesionalni je bodovni turnir World Snooker Toura koji se održava u Shenzhenu u Kini, a prvi je put održan 2026. Natjecanje se igra po sustavu izravne eliminacije, pri čemu se broj frameova u mečevima povećava u kasnijim kolima, sve do finala koje se igra na 10 dobivenih frameova. Nastavlja tradiciju turnira koji se prethodno održavao pod nazivom Xi’an Grand Prix te, za razliku od pozivnih turnira poput Shanghai Mastersa, dodjeljuje novčane nagrade koje se uračunavaju u... službenu svjetsku ljestvicu.

programme.title: Alpsko skijanje: Svetski kup 2025-26, Vengen, Švajcarska, Spust za muškarce
programme.desc: FIS Svjetski kup u alpskom skijanju međunarodno je natjecanje najviše razine u alpskom skijanju, koje od 1967. organizira Međunarodna skijaška i snowboard federacija (FIS). Okuplja najbolje svjetske alpske skijaše i skijašice koji predstavljaju nacionalne saveze, a tijekom zimske sezone obuhvaća utrke spusta, superveleslaloma, veleslaloma i slaloma u velikim planinskim skijalištima diljem Europe, Sjeverne Amerike i drugih regija. Natjecatelji se utrkuju na vrijeme i prikupljaju bodove na... temelju ostvarenog plasmana. Odvojeni ukupni poredci i poredci po disciplinama za muškarce i žene određ uju pobjednike Svjetskog kupa u pojedinoj sezoni, kojima se dodjeljuju prestižni kristalni globusi.

programme.title: Alpsko skijanje: Svetski kup 2025-26, Kicbil, Austrija, spust za muškarce
programme.desc: Natjecanje Hahnenkamm prvi put je održano 1931. godine i predstavlja godišnje natjecanje u alpskom skijanju koje se održava u Kitzbühelu u Austriji. Natjecanje je nazvano po planini Hahnenkamm, koja se nalazi zapadno od Kitzbühela i na kojoj se održavaju sva natjecanja. Natjecanje počinje u petak sa Super-G utrkom. U subotu se održava poznati spust na stazi pod nazivom Die Streif. U nedjelju se natjecanje završava slalomom.

programme.title: Biciklizam: UCI Women's World Tour, pregled sezone 2026
programme.desc: UCI-jeva ženska svjetska turneja najviša je međunarodna serija profesionalnih ženskih cestovnih biciklističkih utrka, koju organizira Međunarodna biciklistička unija (UCI). Pokrenuta 2016., okuplja vodeće biciklistice i profesionalne ekipe koje se natječu na prestižnim jednodnevnim klasicima i etapnim utrkama na nekoliko kontinenata. Kalendar uključuje velika natjecanja kao što su Tour de France Femmes, Giro d'Italia Women i Paris–Roubaix Femmes. Svaka utrka ima svoju pobjednicu i zasebne... poretke, a rezultati donose bodove za međunarodne ljestvice biciklistica i ekipa UCI-ja.

programme.title: Tadej Pogačar: Anatomija najboljeg biciklista svih vremena
programme.desc: (Tadej Pogacar: Anatomy of a GOAT) S pet pobjeda na Tour de Franceu i dva uzastopna naslova svjetskog prvaka u cestovnom biciklizmu pod okriljem UCI-ja, otkrijte što je slovenskog biciklista Tadeja Pogačara dovelo na vrh suvremenog biciklizma.

programme.title: Skijaški skokovi: Planica7, Svetski kup, ski-letovi HS 240, muškarci, 2. dan
programme.desc: Svjetski kup u skijaškim skokovima godišnja je serija međunarodnih natjecanja u zimskim sportovima koju organizira Međunarodna skijaška i snowboard federacija (FIS). Okuplja najbolje skijaše skakače i skakačice svijeta na skakaonicama u više zemalja. Utemeljena je 1979. godine, a natjecanja za žene uvedena su 2011. godine. Obuhvaća pojedinačna i ekipna natjecanja na skakaonicama normalne i velike veličine te na letaonicama. Skokovi se ocjenjuju prema duljini, tehnici i prilagodbama za... vremenske uvjete, a bodovi prikupljeni tijekom sezone određuju ukupne pobjednike Svjetskog kupa u muškoj i ženskoj konkurenciji.

programme.title: Jedrenje: SailGP Dubai 2026, pregled
programme.desc: Velika nagrada Dubaija u jedrenju godišnje je međunarodno jedriličarsko natjecanje koje se održava u luci Mina Rashid u Dubaiju, u Ujedinjenim Arapskim Emiratima, u sklopu prvenstva SailGP. Prvi put održano 2022. godine, okuplja vrhunske nacionalne jedriličarske timove koji se u kratkim, brzim flotnim utrkama natječu na jednakim katamaranima F50 s podvodnim krilima. Timovi tijekom dva dana natjecanja skupljaju bodove, a tri najbolje plasirane posade ulaze u odlučujuću završnu utrku.... Rezultati natjecanja ujedno se ubrajaju u ukupni poredak prvenstva SailGP tijekom sezone.

programme.title: Snuker: Open Velike Britanije, finale: Mark Selby - Jak Jones
programme.desc: British Open profesionalni je bodovni turnir u snookeru u sklopu World Snooker Toura. Prvi je put održan 1980., a status rangirnog turnira stekao je 1985. Nakon 2004. uklonjen je iz kalendara, da bi ponovno bio pokrenut 2021. Turnir je poznat po prepoznatljivom sustavu nasumičnog ždrijeba, pri čemu se parovi ponovno izvlače nakon svakog kola umjesto da slijede unaprijed određenu turnirsku shemu. Pobjednik dobiva Trofej Clivea Evertona.

programme.title: Brdski biciklizam: Svetski kup, olimpijski kros-kantri, pregled sezone 2026, UCI Mountain Bike World Series
programme.desc: UCI-jeva Svjetska serija u brdskom biciklizmu krovna je međunarodna serija koja objedinjuje nekoliko zasebnih UCI-jevih svjetskih kupova u brdskom biciklizmu pod zajedničkim kalendarom, platformom za natjecanja i komercijalnim identitetom. Pokrenuli su je 2023. godine UCI i Warner Bros. Discovery. Nakon odluke o isključivanju Svjetskog kupa u enduru iz serije nakon sezone 2026., njezin program obuhvaća svjetske kupove u spustu, krosu na kratkoj stazi i krosu, pri čemu se natjecatelji u... svakoj disciplini zasebno bore za ukupni naslov pobjednika Svjetskog kupa.

programme.title: Konjički sport: Global Champions Tour, Verona, Italija, preponsko jahanje
programme.desc: Global Champions Tour elitna je međunarodna serija natjecanja u preponskom jahanju kategorije CSI s pet zvjezdica za pojedinačne jahače i konje, koju je 2006. osnovao olimpijski prvak Jan Tops. Jahači skupljaju bodove za prvenstvo na natjecanjima Grand Prix koja se održavaju diljem svijeta, a najbolji rezultati ulaze u ukupni poredak sezone. Svako natjecanje Grand Prix u pravilu se odlučuje u jednom krugu, nakon kojeg se po potrebi održava baraž. Format je znatno izmijenjen 2017., kada je... uvedena i Global Champions League kao zasebno ekipno natjecanje, dok je Global Champions Tour ostao po jedinačno prvenstvo.

programme.title: Ciklokros: HG Cross, Lokeren, Belgija, muškarci
programme.desc: Rapencross Lokeren godišnja je međunarodna utrka u ciklokrosu koja se održava u parku Park ter Beuken u belgijskom Lokerenu, kao dio serije HG Cross. Utrka se održava od 2018. godine i okuplja vodeće bicikliste i biciklistice koji se natječu na zahtjevnoj terenskoj stazi sa šumskim dionicama, blatom, tehničkim preprekama i prepoznatljivim usponom Mont Henri. Odvojene utrke održavaju se u elitnoj i juniorskoj kategoriji.

programme.title: Ciklo-kros: X2O Trofej, Beringen, žene
programme.desc: Ciklokros u Beringenu, službeno poznat kao Be-MINE Cross, godišnja je međunarodna ciklokros utrka koja se održava na području nekadašnjeg rudarskog kompleksa u belgijskom Beringenu. Utrka je pokrenuta 2019., a od sezone 2026./27. dio je serije X?O Badkamers Trofee. Okuplja vrhunske bicikliste i biciklistice koji se natječu na zahtjevnoj terenskoj stazi sa strmim usponima, tehnički zahtjevnim spustovima i kamenitim dijelovima. Pobjednici pojedinačnih utrka određuju se prema redoslijedu... prolaska kroz cilj, a vremenske razlike utječu na ukupni poredak serije X?O Badkamers Trofee.

programme.title: Biciklizam: Cycling show, magazin, epizoda 10

programme.title: Snuker: Serija domaćih nacija, Open Severne Irske 2026, finale, 2. sesija
programme.desc: Otvoreno prvenstvo Sjeverne Irske u snookeru profesionalni je snooker turnir koji se održava u Belfastu. Turnir postoji od 2016. godine te zajedno sa otvorenim prvenstvima Engleske, Škotske i Walesa čini grupu turnira pod nazivom Serija domaćih nacija. Igrači se natječu za trofej Alexa Higginsa.

programme.title: Golf: PGA Tour, RSM klasik, Dan 4
programme.desc: RSM Classic godišnji je profesionalni golf turnir za muškarce koji se održava u golf klubu Sea Island u američkoj saveznoj državi Georgiji, u sklopu jesenskog dijela natjecanja FedExCup na PGA Touru. Turnir je pokrenut 2010. godine, a na njemu se vodeći svjetski golferi natječu u pojedinačnoj igri na broj udaraca tijekom 72 rupe. Prva se kola igraju na terenima Seaside i Plantation, a završna na terenu Seaside. Kao tradicionalno posljednji turnir jesenskog dijela FedExCupa, dodjeljuje... novčane nagrade i bodove za ljestvicu koji utječu na pravo nastupa igrača u sljedećoj sezoni.

programme.title: Konjički sport: Global Champions League, Verona, Italija, preponsko jahanje
programme.desc: Global Champions Tour elitna je međunarodna serija natjecanja u preponskom jahanju kategorije CSI s pet zvjezdica za pojedinačne jahače i konje, koju je 2006. osnovao olimpijski prvak Jan Tops. Jahači skupljaju bodove za prvenstvo na natjecanjima Grand Prix koja se održavaju diljem svijeta, a najbolji rezultati ulaze u ukupni poredak sezone. Svako natjecanje Grand Prix u pravilu se odlučuje u jednom krugu, nakon kojeg se po potrebi održava baraž. Format je znatno izmijenjen 2017., kada je... uvedena i Global Champions League kao zasebno ekipno natjecanje, dok je Global Champions Tour ostao po jedinačno prvenstvo.

programme.title: Utrke izdržljivosti: Svjetsko prvenstvo, 24 sata Le Mansa, Francuska, pregled
programme.desc: 24 sata Le Mansa godišnja je utrka izdržljivosti sportskih automobila koja se održava na stazi Circuit de la Sarthe u Francuskoj, u organizaciji automobilskog kluba ACO. Prvi put održana je 1923., a od 2012. dio je FIA Svjetskog prvenstva u utrkama izdržljivosti. Utrka traje neprekidno 24 sata, pri čemu se za upravljačem svakog automobila izmjenjuje više vozača, a strategiju određuju gorivo, gume, zaustavljanja u boksu, pouzdanost i promjenjivi uvjeti na stazi. Danas se u utrci istodobno... natječe nekoliko klasa, uključujući Hypercar, LMP2 i LMGT3, a uz prestižnu ukupnu pobjedu dodjeljuju se i pobjede u pojedinim klasama.
